• Ukugcina indawo ekhululekileyo ejikeleze isithuthi sakho ngalo lonke ixesha kuthetha ukuba uzigcina ukude kwiingozi ezinokuvela, kwaye uzinika indawo yokusilawula nokusabela.
  • Xa ugqitha esinye isithuthi, utshintsha imizila okanye ungena endleleni, musa ukungena kufutshane kakhulu phambi kwabanye. Ngena ushiya umgama owaneleyo emva okanye phambi kwezinye iimoto.

nav.defensiveDriving.clearSpace.1.descri.text:
• Xa ulandela esinye isithuthi, shiya umgama wokulandela wemizuzwana eyi-2.
  • Ukuze ubale umgama wakho wokulandela, vumela imoto ephambi kwakho idlule kwinto engashukumiyo, njengepali yesibane okanye uphawu olusecaleni kwendlela, uze xa idlula ubale kancinci uthi 'Umzuzwana omnye, imizuzwana emibini'. Imoto yakho kufuneka idlule kuloo nto xa ugqiba ukuthi 'imizuzwana emibini'.
  • Umgama ngokwawo uyahluka ngokwesantya: xa uhamba ngesantya esiphezulu, umgama wokulandela wemizuzwana emibini uthetha ukuba ukude ngakumbi emva kwenye imoto. Xa uhamba kancinci, umgama wokulandela usengowemizuzwana emibini, kodwa usondele ngakumbi kwenye imoto.
  • Umgama wokulandela ukunika ixesha lokusabela. Ukuba imoto ephambi kwakho iqhobosha ngesiquphe, kubakho ukulibaziseka okuncinane ngoxa ingqondo yakho ibona oku, igqiba ekubeni uqhoboshe, luze unyawo lwakho lucinezele isiqhoboshi ize imoto ime.
  • Ukuba isithuthi sakho sithwele umthwalo onzima, okanye kukho abantu abaninzi kuso, sithatha ixesha elide ukuma. Yandisa umgama wakho wokulandela.
  • Kwiimeko ezimbi (umzekelo ebusuku, xa kunetha okanye kukho inkungu), shiya umgama wokulandela wemizuzwana eyi-4.
  • Izithuthi ezinzima kufuneka zishiye umsantsa wemizuzwana eyi-3 kwiimeko eziqhelekileyo, nangaphezulu kwiimeko ezimbi.

nav.defensiveDriving.clearSpace.2.descri.text:
• Ukuba umntu ukulandela esondele kakhulu, yandisa umgama wokulandela ophambi kwakho (musa ukuzama ukunyusa isantya).
  • Oku kukunika indawo engakumbi yokulawula isithuthi, kwaye kunokumkhuthaza ukuba akugqithe ukuze angabi sekufutshane nawe.

nav.defensiveDriving.clearSpace.3.descri.text:
• Xa uma emva kwemoto emileyo (umzekelo kwindawo enophawu lokumisa), kufuneka ukwazi ukubona amavili ayo angasemva. Ukuba awukwazi ukuwabona, usondele kakhulu.
  • Isikhokelo esilungileyo kukuma kumgama oyi-4-5m emva kwayo.
  • Kufuneka ukwazi ukuqhuba uphume emva kwayo ngaphandle kokubuya umva.
  • Ukuba usondele kakhulu, xa umntu ekutshayisa ngasemva, usenokutyhalelwa kwimoto ephambi kwakho.
  • Ukuba usondele kakhulu, imoto ephambi kwakho inokuhlehla ikutshayise xa iqalisa ukuhamba.

nav.defensiveDriving.clearSpace.4.descri.text:
• Xa ucinezela iziqhoboshi, imoto ayimi ngoko nangoko.
  • Okukhona uhamba ngesantya esiphezulu, kwaye imoto yakho inzima, kokukhona ithatha ixesha elide ukuma.
  • Kwi-65km/h amathuba okungqubana aphindwe kabini kunakwi-60km/h.
  • Kwi-60km/h uza kuthatha umgama oyi-45m ukuze ume.
  • Ukuba ubuhamba nge-65km/h, xa ufika kumgama oyi-45m ubuya kuba usahamba nge-32km/h.
  • Linganisa umgama oyi-45m endleleni ngokuhamba ngeenyawo. Cinga ngento yokuba, ukuba umntwana ebenokubalekela endleleni phambi kwemoto yakho kanye ngaphambi kwaloo ndawo, ubungenakukwazi ukuma kwangethuba, nokuba ubuhamba nge-60 km/h kuphela.
  • Kwi-100km/h umgama wakho wokuma yi-100m.
  • Kwi-120km/h umgama wakho wokuma yi-130m.

nav.defensiveDriving.generalK53Procedure.text: Kukho amanyathelo ali-10 enza zonke iinkqubo ze-K53. Kwimeko nganye ungasebenzisa onke okanye amanye ala manyathelo. Kwicandelo labaqhubi le-Learn2Drive inkqubo nganye ichazwe ngokweenkcukacha, kodwa apha sikudwelisele amanyathelo aphambili saza sawahlula aba ngamaqela amathathu aphambili.

1. Qwalasela (ngaphambili nakuzo zonke izipili, ukuze uhlole imeko yezithuthi ngokubanzi)
2. Jonga indawo ongayiboniyo kwizipili (ukuze uhlole imeko yezithuthi ngokubanzi)
3. Yenza umqondiso (khumbula ukuba imiqondiso iquka izibane zokujika, izibane zeziqhoboshi, ihuta okanye imiqondiso yezandla)

4. Jonga izipili (zonke izipili, ukuze ubone ukuba kukhuselekile na ukunciphisa isantya)
5. Qhobosha
6. Igiya (tshintsha igiya ukuba kuyimfuneko)

7. Jonga indawo ongayiboniyo kwizipili (kwicala ojikela kulo, ukuze uqinisekise ukuba kukhuselekile. Oku kusoloko kuyinto yokugqibela oyenzayo ngaphambi kokwenza intshukumo ngemoto.)
8. Jika ivili lokuqhuba
9. Nyusa isantya
10. Cima isibane sokujika

Amaqela amathathu aphambili ezenzo kwinkqubo eqhelekileyo ye-K53 angashwankathelwa ngolu hlobo:

nav.defensiveDriving.introToK53.0.descri.text:
• Ngeminyaka yee-1980's urhulumente waseMzantsi Afrika waqwalasela izindululo zenkqubo entsha yovavanyo lweelayisenisi zokuqhuba. Isindululo ngasinye sanikwa inombolo entsha, kwaye uvavanyo olunenombolo engu-53 lulo olwathi ekugqibeleni lwamkelwa.
  • Luyafana novavanyo lwase-UK lweminyaka yee-1980's.
  • Eyona njongo yovavanyo lwe-K53 kukukhuthaza ukuqhuba ngokuzikhusela: ukuzikhusela ngamaxesha onke ekuphulukaneni nolawulo lwesithuthi sakho nakwiingozi zongquzulwano ezinokwenzeka.

nav.defensiveDriving.introToK53.1.descri.text:
Ukuze uqhube ngokuzikhusela kufuneka:
  • Uyazi indlela yokusebenzisa izixhobo zokulawula isithuthi sakho.
  • Uhlale uphaphile ngalo lonke ixesha, uqwalasele okwenzekayo. Oku kuthetha ukujonga macala onke emoto yakho, kuquka kwizipili nakwiindawo ongaziboniyo kwizipili.
  • Ukwazi ukuqaphela izinto eziyingozi.
  • Uyazi indlela yokujongana nezinto eziyingozi.
  • Uzinike ixesha elaneleyo lokusabela kwizinto eziyingozi, ngokugcina umgama owaneleyo wokulandela nangokuhlala ugcina indawo evulekileyo nekhuselekileyo macala onke esithuthi sakho.
  • Uyazi inkqubo esisiseko ye-K53: amanyathelo ali-10 asetyenziswa kwiinkqubo ezininzi zokuqhuba (umz. ukujika, ukugqitha ezinye izithuthi, njl.).

nav.defensiveDriving.introToK53.question.text: Yeyiphi kwezi nkcazelo zilandelayo eyinyani malunga novavanyo lwelayisenisi lwe-K53 eMzantsi Afrika?
(3) Eyona njongo yenkqubo ye-K53 kukukhuthaza ukusetyenziswa kweendawo ezingabonakaliyo kwizipili.
Yazi indlela yokusebenzisa zonke izixhobo zokulawula isithuthi sakho; hlala ulumkele izinto ezinobungozi; shiya indawo eyaneleyo ekungqongileyo ukuze ube nexesha lokujongana nezinto ezinobungozi.
Zazi kakuhle zonke iimpawu zendlela; hlala usilawula isithuthi sakho; gcina izinga lotywala egazini lakho lingaphantsi komda ovumelekileyo.

Yahlula phakathi kwezinto ezinobungozi ezihambayo nezingashukumiyo; gcina isithuthi sakho sikwimeko efanelekileyo yokuhamba endleleni; yiba nomntu okujongayo xa uqhuba ukuba unelayisensi yomfundi kuphela.
Imigaqo ephambili ekufuneka uyilandele xa uqhuba ngokuzikhusela yile:

nav.defensiveDriving.observing.0.descrip.text:
• Ngokubanzi, hlala ujonge indlela ephambi kwakho xa uqhuba. Xa ujonga kwenye indawo, umzekelo ukuze ujonge izibuko zakho, kwenze ngokukhawuleza uze uphinde ujonge phambili.
  • Jonga zontathu izibuko zakho rhoqo kwimizuzwana eyi-5-8. Kuvavanyo lwakho uza kutsalwa amanqaku ukuba awukwenzi oku.
  • Jonga nezixhobo zokulinganisa zesithuthi sakho ngamaxesha athile: jonga isantya sakho nokuba kukho naziphi na izibane ezilumkisayo.
  • Jonga iindawo ongaziboniyo kwizibuko ngalo lonke ixesha usiya kwelinye icala lendlela, umzekelo xa usuka ecaleni kwendlela, utshintsha imizila okanye ujika.

nav.defensiveDriving.observing.1.descrip.text:
• Ezi ziindawo ezijikeleze imoto yakho ongakwaziyo ukuzibona kwizibuko zokujonga ngasemva.
  • Usenokujonga izibuko zakho, ungaboni zimoto uze ujike... uze utshayise imoto ebikwindawo ongayiboniyo kwizibuko.
  • Ukujonga indawo ongayiboniyo ngasekunene, jika intloko yakho ngasekunene uze ujonge ngaphaya kwegxalaba lakho ngeefestile zomqhubi nezomkhweli ongasemva.
  • Ukujonga indawo ongayiboniyo ngasekhohlo, jika intloko yakho ngasekhohlo uze ujonge ngaphaya kwegxalaba lakho ngeefestile zomkhweli ongaphambili nezomkhweli ongasemva.
  • Ukujonga indawo ongayiboniyo kwizibuko kufuneka kusoloko kuyinto yokugqibela oyenzayo ngaphambi kokujika okanye ukutshintsha imizila.
  • Jonga nendawo ongayiboniyo kwizibuko ngaphambi kokuvula iingcango zakho.

nav.defensiveDriving.observing.2.descrip.text:
• Hlala emotweni emileyo (kwisihlalo somqhubi).
  • Cela umntu ahambe esiza emotweni evela ngasemva. Makahambe kumgca oyi-2m ukusuka kwicala lomqhubi lemoto.
  • Mjonge kwisipili esikwicala lomqhubi.
  • Xa engasabonakali, ukwindawo ongayiboniyo kwisipili. Mxelele ukuba ame.
  • Jika intloko yakho uze ubone ukuba kufuneka ujonge kude kangakanani ngasemva ukuze umbone.
  • Yiba nomfanekiso-ngqondweni wophawu ngaphakathi emotweni yakho olukubonisa apho kufuneka ujonge khona.

nav.roadSignals.warningSignals.question..text: Kukho indawo yokuwela yabahambi ngeenyawo ngaphambili.
Kukho ingozi ngaphambili kwaye kufuneka uqhubeke ngononophelo.
Umqondiso wesibane esimthubi esidanyazayo usoloko uthetha ukuba:

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.changingLanes.text: Ukutshintsha imizila

• Hlala ngaphakathi kwendlela yakho yokuhamba. Musa ukuhamba phezu komgca owahlula iindlela zokuhamba (xa isithuthi sakho sikwiindlela zokuhamba ezingaphezu kwenye).
  • Tshintsha indlela yokuhamba kuphela xa imigca esendleleni okanye iimpawu zendlela zikuvumela.
  • Bonisa kwangethuba ukuba uzimisele ukutshintsha indlela yokuhamba.
  • Tshintsha indlela yokuhamba kuphela xa kukhuselekile.
  • Into yokugqibela ekufuneka uyenzile ngaphambi kokutshintsha indlela yokuhamba kukujonga iindawo ongaziboniyo kwizipili.
  • Ukuba utshintsha iindlela zokuhamba ezingaphezu kwenye, phinda ujonge iindawo ongaziboniyo kwizipili kwindlela nganye yokuhamba.
Usebenzise umqondiso wesandla.
Ujonge indawo ongayiboniyo kwizipili kabini, kube kanye ngaphambi kokungena kumzila ngamnye.
Ujonge indawo ongayiboniyo kwizipili ngasekunene ubuncinane imizuzwana emibini ngaphambi kokutshintsha umzila okokuqala.
Xa unqumla ngaphezu komzila omnye usiya ngasekunene, kufuneka:
Uqhuba amavili akho asekhohlo ekumzila omnye, aze amavili akho asekunene abe komnye.
Unqumla imizila emibini kuhola wendlela.
Uqhuba ngaphakathi komgca omthubi osekhohlo kwendlela.
Ukuhamba phakathi kwemizila emibini kuxa:
Nika umqondiso wento oceba ukuyenza.
Jonga ukuba kukho na iimpawu ezipeyintwe endleleni okanye imiqondiso yendlela ekwalelayo ukutshintsha umzila.
Jonga indawo ongayiboniyo kwizipili.
Eyona nto yokugqibela ekufuneka uyenze ngaphambi kokutshintsha umzila yile:
(1) no-(2) zichanekile.
Ngu-(2) kuphela ochanileyo.
Zonke ezi nketho zichanekile.
Yeyiphi kwezi zilandelayo eyinyani?
(1) Kwindlela ekuhanjwa kuyo kwicala elinye kuphela, amavili akho asekunene angahamba phakathi kwemizila emibini.
(2) Kufuneka utshintshe umzila kuphela xa kukhuselekile ukwenza njalo.
(3) Akuvumelekanga ukuba utshintshe umzila kuhola wendlela.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.dividedRoads..text:
• Ezi ziindlela ezahlulwe zangamacandelo angaphezu kwelinye ngomgca okanye ngomqobo.
  • Hlala ngasekhohlo kwendlela eyahluliweyo (ngaphandle kokuba yindlela eya kwicala elinye).
  • Wela isahluli kuphela kwindawo evulekileyo okanye kwisiphambuka, okanye apho uphawu olupeyintwe endleleni okanye ipolisa likuvumela ukuba uwele.
Kukho uphawu oluthintela ukudlula ezinye izithuthi.
Awuwelanga naziphi na izithintelo okanye imigca eqhubekayo ephawulwe endleleni ukuze ufike apho.
Eyona moto ikufutshane ezayo kwelinye icala iza kufika emva kwe-2 seconds.
Uvumelekile ukuqhuba kwicala lasekunene lendlela enezithuthi ezihamba kumacala omabini ukuba:
Indlela ehamba izithuthi kwicala elinye enemizila emibini.
Indlela ehamba izithuthi kumacala omabini kodwa enomzila omnye kuphela kwicala ngalinye.
Indlela yokuphuma kuhola wendlela enomzila omnye.
Yeyiphi kwezi zilandelayo engeyiyo indlela eyahluliweyo?
Kuphela xa izibane zakho zongxamiseko zilayitiwe.
Xa uyalelwe ligosa lezendlela ukuba wenze njalo.
Uvumelekile nini ukuqhuba kwicala lasekunene lendlela yoluntu enezithuthi ezihamba kumacala omabini?
Usoloko uqhuba ngasekunene, nokuba mingaphi na imizila.
Uwele naziphi na izahluli zendlela kuphela apho kukho isithuba sokuwela
Kwindlela ehamba izithuthi kwicala elinye kufuneka:

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.intersections.text: Iindawo ezidibana kuzo iindlela

• Yima ngokupheleleyo ngaphambi komgca wokuma kwiindlela ezineempawu zokuma naxa iirobhothi zibomvu.
  • Imiyalelo yegosa lezendlela isoloko ibaluleke ngaphezu kweempawu zendlela, imiqondiso (kuquka iirobhothi) nemigca esendleleni.
  • Kwiindawo zokuma ezinamacala ayi-3 okanye ayi-4, iimoto kufuneka zihambe ngokulandelelana kokufika kwazo. Vumela nabani na owayesele ekwisiphambuka ukufika kwakho ukuba ahambe ngaphambi kwakho.
  • Iirobhothi ezidanyaza zibomvu zisebenza njengeendawo zokuma ezinamacala amane. Kufuneka ume ngokupheleleyo (unganeli nje ukuthoba isantya). Ofike kuqala uhamba kuqala.
Iindlela ezineempawu zokuma neerobhothi
• Nika indlela abo sele bekwisangqa abasondela kuwe bevela ngasekunene.
Izangqa zendlela
• Yima ukuze udlulise abantu abakwindawo yokuwela yabahambi ngeenyawo kwicala lakho okanye abasondela kuyo kwicala lakho.
Iindawo zokuwela zabahambi ngeenyawo

• Bonisa ukuba uza kujika malunga nemizuzwana eyi-5 ngaphambi kokufika kwindawo ofuna ukujika kuyo.
  • Hlala kufutshane necala lasekhohlo kangangoko kunokwenzeka ngaphambi kokujika.
  • Wakuba ujikile, lungisa isantya sakho ukuze ungene ekuhambeni kwezithuthi.
  • Cima isalathisi sakho emva kokujika.
Ukujikela ngasekhohlo kwisiphambuka

• Bonisa ukuba uza kujika malunga nemizuzwana eyi-5 ngaphambi kokufika kwindawo ofuna ukujika kuyo.
  • Hlala kufutshane necala lasekunene kangangoko kunokwenzeka ngaphambi kokujika (ungaweli umgca owahlulayo ungene kwicala lezithuthi ezizayo).
  • Nika indlela izithuthi ezisondelayo.
  • Dlula ngaphaya komgca osembindini wendlela oza kujikela kuyo ngaphambi kokujika (ngaphandle kokuba yindlela ekuhanjwa kuyo kwicala elinye kuphela).
  • Ukuba kukho isiqithi sokwahlula izithuthi okanye igosa lezendlela kwisiphambuka, dlula ngasekhohlo kwaso okanye kwalo.
  • Wakuba ujikile, lungisa isantya sakho ukuze ungene ekuhambeni kwezithuthi.
  • Cima isalathisi sakho emva kokujika.
Ukujikela ngasekunene kwisiphambuka

• Xa isithuthi sakho siza kuthintela ukuhamba kwezithuthi.
  • Musa ukuwela okanye ukujikela kwenye indlela ngaphandle kokuba kukho indawo eyaneleyo evulekileyo kwelinye icala ukuze uwele ngokupheleleyo ngaphandle kokubeka izithuthi engozini okanye ukuzithintela.
  • Musa ukuwela iziphambuka eziphawulwe ngeebhokisi ngaphandle kokuba unendawo eyaneleyo kwelinye icala ukuze uphume ngokupheleleyo kwisiphambuka ngaphambi kokuma.
Xa ungafanele ungene kwisiphambuka
Zihambe ngokulandelelana kokufika kwazo.
Zithobele izibane zendlela kuqala kunemiyalelo yegosa lezendlela.
Zime ngokupheleleyo emva komgca wokumisa.
Kwizibane zendlela ezibomvu ezingadanyaziyo, iimoto kufuneka:

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.Intersections.text: (1) Ungamisa ngaphakathi kwisiphambuka kuphela ixesha elaneleyo lokwehlisa abakhweli.
(2) Abahambi ngeenyawo abasele beqalisile ukuwela indlela xa kulayita uphawu lomntu obomvu kufuneka balinde kumgca osembindini wendlela de zonke iimoto zidlule.
(3) Kufuneka unike izithuthi eziza ngakuwe ithuba lokudlula ukuba ujikela ekhohlo.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.intersections.text: Izibane zendlela ezibomvu ezidanyazayo neziphambuka ezineempawu zokumisa kumacala ama-4 ziphathwa ngendlela efanayo.
Usoloko unelungelo lokuhamba kuqala kwisiphambuka esineempawu zokumisa kumacala ama-3.
Amagosa ezendlela kufuneka eme ngasekhohlo kwesiphambuka esinophawu lokumisa xa elawula izithuthi.
Ngokuphathelele iziphambuka ezinophawu lokumisa, yeyiphi kwezi nkcazelo ilandelayo eyinyani:
Uqalise ukujika ngaphambi kokuba uwele umgca osembindini wendlela ongena kuyo.
Ujike ungene kumzila ongasekunene wendlela ongena kuyo.
Uqalise ukujika emva kokuba uwele umgca osembindini wendlela ongena kuyo.
Xa ujikela ngasekunene ungena kwindlela enezithuthi ezihamba kumacala omabini, kufuneka:
Akufuneki ume phezu kwendawo ephawulwe ngebhokisi.
Kufuneka unike indlela izithuthi ezivela ngasekunene.
Unelungelo lokuhamba kuqala.
Ukuba kukho indawo ephawulwe ngebhokisi kwisiphambuka:
Ukuba isithuthi sakho siza kuthintela ukuhamba kwezithuthi.
Ngaphandle kokuba uyalelwe ligosa lezendlela ukuba wenze njalo.
Ngaphandle kokuba kukho irobhothi edanyaza ngokuluhlaza.
Akuvumelekanga ukuba ungene kwisiphambuka:
Uhlehle ngoko nangoko ubuyele kumgca wokumisa osemva kwakho.
Uye ecaleni kwendlela uze ume.
Ulinde de kukhuseleke, uze uqhubeke ngokukhawuleza kangangoko kunokwenzeka.
Ukuba sele ungene kwisiphambuka yaza irobhothi yatshintsha yaba orenji, kufuneka:
Izithuthi ezilula.
Abakhweli beebhayisekile.
Abahambi ngeenyawo.
Leliphi kula maqela mathathu elinelungelo lokuhamba kuqala kwisiphambuka?
Kusebusuku yaye ungaphandle kommandla wasezidolophini.
Awuvumelekanga ukwenza oku nangaliphi na ixesha.
Uyalelwe ukuba wenze njalo ligosa lezendlela.
Ungadlula ngqo kwisiphambuka esinophawu lokumisa ngaphandle kokuma ukuba:
Unelungelo lokuhamba kuqala.
Kufuneka unike indlela izithuthi ezivela ngasekunene.
Kufuneka unike indlela izithuthi ezivela ngasekhohlo.
Kwizangqa zendlela:
Ujonge ukuba kukho ezinye izithuthi eziza ngasekunene uze ungene ukuba kukhuselekile.
Ulinde de imoto obusemva kwayo iphume kwisangqa ngaphambi kokuba ungene.
Udanyazise izibane zakho zangaphambili ngokufutshane ukuze ulumkise umqhubi waloo moto ukuba uza kungena.
Ukuba ulinde emva kwenye imoto ukuze ungene kwisangqa sendlela, yakuba ingenile loo moto kufuneka:
(1) no-(2) kuphela.
(2) no-(3) kuphela.
(1) no-(3) kuphela.
Yeyiphi kwezi zilandelayo ongavumelekanga ukuyenza?
(1) Ukudlula isithuthi esilinde abahambi ngeenyawo kwindawo yokuwela yabahambi ngeenyawo.
(2) Ukujikela ngasekhohlo kwisiphambuka.
(3) Ukujikela ngasekunene xa ungena kwisangqa sezithuthi.
Kufuneka ubonise injongo yakho yokujika malunga nemizuzwana eyi-... ngaphambi kokuba ujike.
Ukucima isalathisi sakho emva kokujikela ngasekhohlo.
Ukucima isalathisi sakho emva kokujikela ngasekunene.
Ukungabonisi ngesalathisi xa ujikela ngasekhohlo.
Akukho mthethweni:
Usandul' ukujikela ngasekhohlo.
Usandul' ukujikela ngasekunene.
Usandul' ukujikela ngasekhohlo okanye ngasekunene.
Kufuneka uhlengahlengise isantya sakho ukuze ungene ekuhambeni kwezithuthi kwindlela osandul' ukujikela kuyo xa:
Ngasekhohlo.
Ngasekunene.
Kwirobhothi enotolo oluluhlaza oludanyazayo olukhomba ngasekhohlo.
Xa ujika, kufuneka ubeke isithuthi sakho kufutshane kangangoko kukhuselekile necala lendlela oza kujikela kulo. Oku kunokungena kwindawo yezithuthi eziza ngakuwe xa ujikela:

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.overtaking.0..text:
• Umgaqo oqhelekileyo wendlela kukuhlala ngasekhohlo, ugqithe ngasekunene.
  • Xa ugqitha, gcina indawo evulekileyo ejikeleze isithuthi sakho neso usigqithayo (musa ukubuyela phambi kwaso usondele kakhulu).
  • Ukuba ugqitha into okanye isithuthi esimi ndawonye (umzekelo ibhasi), lumkela abantu abanokuphuma bahambe phambi kwaso.
  • Bonisa ukuba uzimisele ukugqitha.
  • Xa ulungiselela ukugqitha, musa ukungena kwicala lasekunene lendlela ngendlela ebeka izithuthi ezizayo engozini.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.overtaking.1..text:
• Iimpawu ezithintela ukugqitha okanye imigca esendleleni (imigca engaphukanga) zikuthintela.
  • Ukwindawo yokuwela yabahambi ngeenyawo.
  • Ngaphandle kokuba ungakwazi ukugqitha ngaphandle kokungena kwicala lasekunene lendlela (ngamanye amazwi, ukuba indlela ibanzi ngokwaneleyo) okanye ukuba yindlela ekuhanjwa kuyo kwicala elinye kuphela, akuvumelekanga ukugqitha xa:
    • Ungayiboni indlela engaphambili okanye izithuthi ezizayo.
    • Ukufutshane nencopho yethambeka (usondela encotsheni yenduli).
    • Ukwigophe okanye ekoneni apho ungakwazi ukubona indlela engaphambili.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.overtaking.2..text:
• Awuvumelekanga nanini na ukuqhuba egxalabeni lendlela, kumhlaba osecaleni kwendlela okanye ngasekhohlo komgca womphetho wendlela ukuze ugqithe esinye isithuthi.
  • Logama ungakwenzi oku, ungagqitha ngasekhohlo:
    • Xa umqhubi ophambi kwakho ejikela ngasekunene
    • Ukuba indlela ihamba kwicala elinye kwaye ibanzi ngokwaneleyo ukuba kungahamba iimoto ezimbini ecaleni kwenye (kwindawo yasezidolophini)
    • Ukuba umzila okuwo ubanzi ngokwaneleyo ukuba kungahamba iimoto ezimbini ecaleni kwenye (kwindawo yasezidolophini)
    • Ukuba kukho ngaphezu komzila omnye oya kwicala oya ngakulo
    • Ukuba igosa lezendlela likuyalela ukuba wenze njalo.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.overtaking.3..text:
• Hlala ngasekhohlo kangangoko kukhuselekile.
  • Gcina isantya esingaguqukiyo. Musa ukusinyusa isantya.
  • Ungangena egxalabeni lendlela xa esinye isithuthi sigqitha kuwe phantsi kweemeko ezithile (jonga ngezantsi).

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.overtaking.4..text:
• Igxalaba lendlela yindawo engaphaya komgca otyheli ngasekhohlo kwendlela.
  • Uvumelekile ukuqhuba kulo kuphela xa:
    • Ungena egxalabeni lendlela ukuze uvumele esinye isithuthi sigqithe kuwe, kwaye
    • Kukho umzila omnye kuphela oya kwicala ngalinye, kwaye
    • Kukhuselekile ukwenza njalo, kwaye
    • Uyakwazi ukubona ngaphambili kumgama ongama-150m ubuncinane, kwaye
    • Kusemini (phakathi kokuphuma nokutshona kwelanga).

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.overtaking.5..text:
• Ukuba ukumzila 'okhawulezayo' (owona mzila ungasekunene oya kwicala oya ngakulo) kuhola wendlela kwaye ufuna ukugqitha isithuthi esiphambi kwakho, ungadanyazisa izibane zakho zangaphambili kumqhubi waso.
  • Ukuba ukumzila okhawulezayo kwaye omnye umqhubi ukudanyazisela izibane ukubonisa ukuba ufuna ukugqitha kuwe, yiya ngasekhohlo ngokukhawuleza xa kukhuselekile ukwenza njalo.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.overtaking.qu.text: Gcina izibane zangaphambili zesithuthi sakho zikhanyisiwe.
Hlala ngasekhohlo, udlule ngasekunene.
Hlala ngasekunene, udlule ngasekhohlo.
Umgaqo oqhelekileyo wendlela uthi:
Inombolo (1) kuphela.
Ngu-(1) no-(2) kuphela.
Ngu-(1) no-(3) kuphela.
Ukudlula ligama elisetyenziswa ukuchaza ukujikeleza okanye ukudlula kweyiphi kwezi zilandelayo:
(1) Isithuthi esihamba kwicala elinye nawe.
(2) Isithuthi esihamba kwicala elichaseneyo nelo uhamba kulo.
(3) Into engashukumiyo.
Xa udlula, ekugqibeleni ubuyela kumzila obuqale kuwo, kodwa xa utshintsha imizila uba kumzila owahlukileyo.
Xa utshintsha imizila kufuneka ujonge iindawo ongakwaziyo ukuzibona kwizipili kabini, kodwa xa udlula kufuneka uzijonge kube kanye kuphela.
Ungadlula iimoto ezimbini ngaxeshanye, kodwa ungatshintsha umzila omnye kuphela ngexesha.
Umahluko phakathi kokudlula nokutshintsha imizila kukuba:
Kufuneka uhlale ngasekhohlo kangangoko kunokwenzeka.
Kufuneka wazise ipolisa lezendlela ngoko nangoko.
Akuvumelekanga ukuba wongeze isantya.
Xa esinye isithuthi sikudlula ngasekhohlo:
Udlule ezinye izithuthi ngasekhohlo ukuba zijikela ngasekunene.
Udlule ezinye izithuthi ngasekhohlo xa zijikela ngasekunene, ukuba nje awungeni kwigxalaba lendlela
Akuvumelekanga ukuba udlule izithuthi ngasekhohlo.
Kwindlela kawonke-wonke, uvumelekile ukuba:
Akuvumelekanga nangaliphi na ixesha ukuba ungene kwigxalaba lendlela (umqukumbelo wendlela okanye umgca omthubi ngasekhohlo).
Ungangena kwigxalaba lendlela kuphela phakathi kokutshona kwelanga nokuphuma kwelanga, kwaye kuphela ukuba ungabona ngokucacileyo phambi kwakho kumgama oyi-150m.
Ungangena kwigxalaba lendlela kuphela ukuba kukho umntu oza kukudlula kwaye kukho umzila omnye kuphela oya kwicala ngalinye.
Yeyiphi kwezi nkcazelo zilandelayo eyinyani?
Ukudanyazisa izibane zakho zangaphambili komnye umqhubi kuhola wendlela xa ufuna ukumdlula.
Ukukhalisa ihutha komnye umqhubi kuhola wendlela xa ufuna ukumdlula.
Ukuqhuba kumgaqo wezithuthi ezikhawulezayo (owona usekunene) kuhola wendlela.
Akukho mthethweni:
Usuke uye kwicala lasekhohlo lendlela.
Ubhale phantsi inombolo yobhaliso, uhlobo nemodeli yemoto yakhe.
Uxele isiganeko kwisikhululo samapolisa esikufutshane kwiiyure ezingama-24.
Ukuba omnye umqhubi ukudanyazisela izibane zakhe zangaphambili kuhola wendlela, kufuneka:
Abantu abanokuphuma ngasemva kwayo behamba ngeenyawo.
Isithunzi sayo.
Umsi ophuma kumbhobho wayo wokukhupha umsi.
Xa udlula ibhasi emileyo kufuneka ulumkele:
(1) kuphela.
(1) no-(2) kuphela.
(3) kuphela.
Xa udlula esinye isithuthi ngasekunene, kufuneka ubonise indlela oza kuya kuyo ngezalathisi ngolu hlobo:
(1) Phambi kokuba uye kwicala lasekunene lendlela.
(2) Phambi kokuba ubuyele kwicala lasekhohlo lendlela.
(3) Xa sele ubuyele ngokupheleleyo kumgaqo obusuka kuwo.
Isithuthi sakho.
Isithuthi osidlulayo.
Zombini izithuthi.
Xa udlula esinye isithuthi, kufuneka uqinisekise ukuba kukho indawo evulekileyo ejikeleze:
Usondela encotsheni yenduli.
Usihla endulini.
Kukho umsele ecaleni kwendlela.
Awuvumelekanga ukudlula esinye isithuthi xa:
Indlela yahluliwe kwaye kuza kufuneka unqumle umgca oqhubekayo.
Kuza kufuneka uye kwicala lasekunene lendlela ukuze usidlule.
Ubona igosa lezendlela.
Awuvumelekanga ukudlula esinye isithuthi xa:
Usidlule ngegiya yesithathu ukuze ube namandla angakumbi xa uwadinga.
Unyuse isantya ukuya kutsho kubuninzi be-140km/h ukuze ugqibe ukusidlula ngokukhawuleza kangangoko.
Ungasidluli.
Ukuba awukwazi ukuyibona ngokucacileyo indlela engaphambili xa udlula esinye isithuthi, kufuneka:
Akukho mthethweni ukwenza oko.
Ukuba umqhubi ophambi kwakho ujikela ngasekunene, ungamdlula kwigxalaba lendlela elingasekhohlo.
Ungakwenza oko kwisitalato esihamba izithuthi kwicala elinye nesinemizila emibini.
Ngokuphathelele ukudlula ngasekhohlo:
Udlule ngasekhohlo apho kukho umzila omnye kuphela kodwa indlela ibanzi ngokwaneleyo ukuba kungangena iimoto ezimbini ecaleni kwenye, ngaphandle kwendawo yasezidolophini.
Udlule xa uyalelwe lipolisa lezendlela ukuba wenze njalo.
Ubonise ngesalathisi ukuba uya ngasekhohlo xa udlula ngasekhohlo.
Akuvumelekanga ukuba:

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.parking.0.des.text:
• Ukupaka kukumisa ixesha elide kunelo lifunekayo lokwehlisa abakhweli okanye lokothula impahla.
  • Nanini na upaka kufuneka usebenzise isiqhoboshi sokupaka/isiqhoboshi sesandla.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.parking.1.des.text:
• Nakweyiphi na indawo ekungavumelekanga ukuma kuyo. Ezi ndawo ziphindwe ngezantsi ngombala obomvu. Akuvumelekanga ukuba upake okanye ume kwezi ndawo.
  • Umbhalo omnyama ubonisa izinto ezisebenza ekupakeni kuphela. Akuvumelekanga ukuba upake kwezi ndawo, kodwa ungama kuzo.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.parking.10.de.text: • Le mithetho ingasentla ayisebenzi kwizithuthi zongxamiseko/zokwakha/zamapolisa ezisemsebenzini nezibonisa izibane ezifanelekileyo zokuzichonga.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.parking.3.des.text:
• Kuhola wendlela (ngaphandle kwendawo emiselwe ukuma).
  • Kwindawo apho indlela inqumla umzila kaloliwe kwinqanaba elinye okanye kumzila kaloliwe.
  • Kwicala lasekunene lendlela ujongene nezithuthi ezizayo (ungama ngasekunene kwendlela eya kwicala elinye).
  • Kwindledlana yabahambi ngeenyawo (nokuba yinxalenye yemoto yakho kuphela).
  • Kwindawo apho ungabangela ingozi okanye uthintelo.
  • Kwisiqithi sezithuthi.
  • Kwindawo okanye kwindledlana ebekelwe abahambi ngeenyawo.
  • Phezu kwesixhobo esivuselela ukusebenza kwerobhothi.
  • Endleleni okanye kumgama ongaphantsi kwe-1m ukusuka emphethweni wendlela ngaphandle kwendawo yasezidolophini.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.parking.4.des.text:
• Umphandle wevili elikufutshane nongqameko lwendlela ungaphezulu kwe-450mm ukusuka kungqameko (ngaphandle kokuba ukwindawo yokupaka ephawuliweyo).
  • Unokufihla uphawu lwendlela.
  • Ububanzi bendlela bungaphantsi kwe-5.5m (ngaphandle kwezitrato eziya kwicala elinye).

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.parking.5.des.text:
• Nemisebenzi yendlela okanye indawo egrunjiweyo okanye omnye umqobo, ukuba oku kungabeka ezinye izithuthi engozini okanye kuzithintele.
  • Nendlela yokungena kwisakhiwo okanye isango.
  • Nesinye isithuthi ukuba ububanzi bendlela bungaphantsi kwe-9m.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.parking.8.des.text:
• Kwitonela.
  • Kwibhulorho (phezu kwayo okanye ngaphantsi kwayo).
  • Kwindlela engaphantsi komhlaba.
  • Kwindlela ecuthwe kububanzi bayo obuqhelekileyo nangasiphi na isizathu.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.parking.9.des.text: • Kwindawo yokuwela yabahambi ngeenyawo, kwicala osuka kulo xa usondela kuyo.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.parking.quest.text: Ukumisa imoto xa kungekho mpahla okanye bakhweli emotweni kunye nawe.
Ukumisa imoto ixesha elide kunelo lifunekayo ukothula impahla okanye ukuhlisa abakhweli.
Ukuphuma emotweni uze uyishiye ingenamntu uyigadileyo, injini ingasebenzi.
Zeziphi kwezi ndawo zilandelayo ekungavumelekanga kuzo ukumisa nokupaka?
(3) Phambi kwendlela yokungena yezithuthi okanye isango.
Kumgama ongaphantsi kwe-6m ukusuka kwindawo apho indlela icuthwe khona.
Kumgama ongaphantsi kwe-5.5m ukusuka kumbhobho wamanzi wokucima umlilo.
Kumgama we-9m emva kokuba udlule kwindawo yokuwela yabahambi ngeenyawo.
Sibeke unxantathu wesilumkiso sikaxakeka kumgama oyi-45m emva kwaso.
Ukuba isithuthi sokwakha sifuna ukupaka kwindawo ekungavumelekanga ukupaka kuyo, kufuneka:
Ngokumalunga nomsebenzi wendlela okanye indawo egrunjiweyo, akuvumelekanga ukupaka:
Icala elingaphakathi levili elikufutshane nongqameko lwendlela kufuneka libe kumgama ongagqithiyo kwi-450mm ukusuka kungqameko lwendlela.
Icala elingaphandle levili elikufutshane nongqameko lwendlela kufuneka libe kumgama ongagqithiyo kwi-450mm ukusuka kungqameko lwendlela.
Xa upakile, ngokomthetho, amavili akho kufuneka abe:
Amavili akho asekhohlo akumgama ongagqithiyo kwi-450mm ukusuka kungqameko lwendlela.
Amavili akho asekunene akumgama ongagqithiyo kwi-450mm ukusuka kungqameko lwendlela.
Unokuba kumgama oyi-550mm okanye ngaphezulu ukusuka kungqameko lwendlela.
Ukuba upake kwindawo yokupaka ephawulweyo kummandla wasezidolophini, kufuneka uqinisekise ukuba:
Yeyiphi kwezi ndawo zilandelayo onokuvunyelwa ukupaka kuyo ebusuku?
(1) Ngaphezu kwe-12m ukusuka kwesona sibane sasesitalatweni sikufutshane kummandla wedolophu.
(3) Kumgama ongaphakathi kwe-9m ngaphambi kwendawo yokuwela yabahambi ngeenyawo, kwicala osuka kulo, ukuba izibane zakho eziphambili zangaphambili zilayitiwe.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.question.0.te.text: Yintoni yokugqibela ekufuneka uyenze ngaphambi kokutshintsha umzila usiya ngasekhohlo?

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.question.1.op.text: Xa uhamba ngqo kwisiphambuka yaye imoto eza kuwe ivela ngaphambili ifuna ukujika ngasekunene.
Xa uhamba ngesantya se-60km/h kummandla wasezidolophini.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.signalling.0..text:
• Sebenzisa izibane zokubonisa ngaphambi kokuba:
    • Ume (izibane zeziqhoboshi)
    • Uthobe isantya ngesiquphe (izibane zeziqhoboshi)
    • Ujike (izalathisi)
    • Utshintshe indlela yokuhamba (izalathisi)
    • Uye ngasekhohlo okanye ngasekunene endleleni (izalathisi).
  • Bonisa kwangethuba (malunga nemizuzwana eyi-5 ngaphambi kokwenza oko, xa usebenzisa izalathisi).
  • Yandisa eli xesha koohola bendlela okanye xa uhamba ngesantya esiphezulu.
  • Qinisekisa ukuba imiqondiso yakho ibonakala ngokucacileyo.
  • Qinisekisa ukuba uyayicima imiqondiso yakho emva kokugqiba loo ntshukumo.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.signalling.1..text:
• Sebenzisa imiqondiso yesandla ukuba izibane zakho zokubonisa azisebenzi.
  • Kusetyenziswa le miqondiso yesandla ilandelayo:
    • Ukuma/ukuthoba isantya ngesiquphe: yolula ingalo yakho yasekunene iye ecaleni ukusuka egxalabeni, uze uyigobe inyuke engqinibeni, intende yesandla sakho ijonge phambili.
    • Ukuthoba isantya: yolula ingalo yakho yasekunene iye ecaleni ukusuka egxalabeni, intende yesandla ijonge phambili, uze uhambise ingalo yakho phezulu nasezantsi ukusuka egxalabeni.
    • Ukujikela ngasekhohlo: yolula ingalo yakho yasekunene iye ecaleni ukusuka egxalabeni, uze uyigobe iye ezantsi engqinibeni, uze ujikelezise isandla sakho kwicala elichasene nokuhamba kwezalathisi zewotshi (abakhweli beebhayisekile nabaqhubi beetrektara nezithuthi ezitsalwa zizilwanyana bangazolula iingalo zabo zasekhohlo ziye ecaleni ukusuka egxalabeni).
    • Ukujikela ngasekunene: yolula ingalo yakho yasekunene iye ecaleni ukusuka egxalabeni, intende yesandla ijonge phambili.
    • Ukugqitha (ubonisa omnye umntu ukuba akugqithe): yolula ingalo yakho yasekunene iye ecaleni ukusuka egxalabeni, intende yesandla ijonge phambili, uze uhambise ingalo yakho ubuye nayo umva naphambili ukusuka egxalabeni.
  • Bonisa kwangethuba (malunga nemizuzwana eyi-5 ngaphambi kokwenza isenzo osibonisayo).
  • Qinisekisa ukuba imiqondiso yakho ibonakala ngokucacileyo ngaphambili, ngasemva nasemacaleni.
  • Ukuba urhuqa esinye isithuthi, sebenzisa imiqondiso yesandla ukubonisa icala oya kulo, kuba izalathisi zakho zisetyenziswa njengemiqondiso yokulumkisa ngengozi.
  • Ukuba izibane zakho zokubonisa azisebenzi, musa ukungena kuhola wendlela. Imiqondiso yesandla ayivumelekanga ngaphandle kwakwimeko yongxamiseko.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.signalling.2..text: • Ukuba kufuneka ume ngenxa yongxamiseko, musa ukwenza umqondiso. Gcina izandla zozibini kwivili lokuqhuba.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.signalling.qu.text: Umqondiso wesandla wokuma (ingalo yasekunene igotywe yaya phezulu, intende yesandla ijonge phambili) kufuneka usetyenziswe xa:
(1)Uqhobosha kuhola wendlela kwaye izibane zakho zeziqhoboshi zingasebenzi.

Ukukhupha ingalo yakho yasekunene uyolule ukusuka egxalabeni, intende yesandla ijonge phambili, luphawu lokuba:

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.speedLimits.0.text:
• Kwimimandla yasezidolophini (iidolophu nezixeko), umda wesantya jikelele yi-60km/h.
  • Kwimimandla yasemaphandleni nakwiindlela zesizwe, umda wesantya jikelele yi-100km/h.
  • Koohola bendlela, umda wesantya jikelele yi-120km/h.
  • Ukuba kukho iimpawu zendlela ezibonisa imida yesantya eyahlukileyo kule, kufuneka kuthotyelwe loo miqondiso yendlela.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.speedLimits.1.text:
• Iiminibhasi ezithwele abakhweli abahlawulayo neebhasi zabakhweli azivumelekanga ukuba zigqithe kwisantya esiyi-100km/h.
  • Izithuthi ezinobunzima obupheleleyo obungaphezu kwe-9 000kg (iilori ezinkulu) azivumelekanga ukuba zigqithe kwisantya esiyi-80km/h.
  • Iitrektara ezikwiindlela zikawonke-wonke azivumelekanga ukuba zigqithe kwisantya esiyi-35km/h.

  • Kwindlela yabahambi ngeenyawo (akuvumelekanga nokuba ibe yinxalenye nje yemoto yakho).
  • Kwindawo apho unokubangela ingozi okanye uthintele indlela.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.stopping.3.de.text:
• Indawo ekulungiswa kuyo indlela, indawo egrunjiweyo okanye esinye isithintelo, ukuba oko kungabeka ezinye izithuthi engozini okanye kuzithintele.
  • Indlela yokungena kwisiza okanye isango.
  • Esinye isithuthi ukuba ububanzi bendlela bungaphantsi kwe-9m.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.towing.0.desc.text:
• Umgama phakathi kwezithuthi ezibini kufuneka ube ngaphantsi kwe-3.5m.
  • Kufuneka zibotshelelwe ngokuqinileyo.
  • Zombini izithuthi kufuneka zibe phantsi kolawulo.
  • Izithuthuthu, izithuthi ezinamavili amathathu, izithuthi ezinamavili amane zohlobo lwe-quad kunye neebhayisekile eziqhutywa ngeepedali azivumelekanga ukutsala izithuthi.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.towing.1.desc.text:
• Ukuba intambo inde ngaphezu kwe-1.8m kufuneka iphawulwe ngeflegi ebomvu.
  • Isithuthi esitsalwayo kufuneka sibe nomqhubi ngaphakathi onelayisenisi yokuqhuba yolo didi lwesithuthi (akufuneki mqhubi ukuba kusetyenziswa intonga yokutsala eqinileyo okanye amavili angaphambili awachukumisi umhlaba).

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.driving.towing.2.desc.text:
• Ungadlula kwisantya sama-30km/h ukuba akukho bakhweli (ziisemi-treyila kuphela ezinokutsalwa ngesantya esingaphezu kwama-30km/h zithwele abakhweli).
  • Isithuthi esitsalwayo asidingi mqhubi.
  • Kufuneka usebenzise intonga yokutsala eqinileyo xa utsala izithuthi ezineziqhoboshi ezingasebenzi kakuhle.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.emergencyTrian.text:

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.lights.1.descr.text:
• Ezi kufuneka zikhanyise ngala maxesha alandelayo:
    • phakathi kokutshona kwelanga nokuphuma kwelanga (kuquka izibane zangasemva nezibane zepleyiti yenombolo)

  • Sebenzisa ukukhanya okuthotyiweyo kwiindawo zasezidolophini okanye xa izithuthi zixinene.
  • Ukukhanya okuthotyiweyo kujongise ezantsi, kwaye akuvumelekanga ukuba kubethe indlela kumgama ongaphezu kwe-45m ngaphambili.
  • Kufanele kukuvumele ukuba ubone imoto okanye umntu kumgama we-45m ngaphambi kwakho.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.lights.2.descr.text:
• Qaphela ukuba ukukhanya kwakho okuphezulu kunokwenza abanye abaqhubi bangakwazi ukubona okwexeshana.

  • Kucime xa uqhuba kanye emva kwesinye isithuthi.
  • Kufanele kukuvumele ukuba ubone imoto okanye umntu kumgama we-100m ngaphambi kwakho.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.lights.3.descr.text:

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.lights.4.descr.text:

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.lights.6.descr.text:

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.lights.7.descr.text:

  • Uvumelekile ukuzisebenzisa kuphela xa:

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.lights.8.descr.text: Zonke iimoto ezikwiindlela zikawonke-wonke kufuneka zibe nezibonakalisi zokukhanya ezibini ezibomvu ngasemva.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.lights.9.descr.text:

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.lights.questio.text: Ngawaphi amaxesha ongavumelekanga ukuqhuba kwindlela kawonke-wonke ukuba izibane zesithuthi sakho azisebenzi?
Izibane zangaphambili zesithuthi sakho kufuneka zibonakale kumntu obona ngokuqhelekileyo kumgama we-... ukusuka kuso.

Ukuze zikulungele ukusetyenziswa endleleni, zonke iimoto kufuneka zibe:
Nezibane ezimhlophe ngaphambili nezibane ezibomvu ngasemva.
Nomntu okhokela izilwanyana ephethe isibane esibomvu kufutshane nentloko yesilwanyana sokuqala.
Kufuneka uzilayite nini izibane zangaphambili zesithuthi sakho?
(1) Xa ungakwazi ukubona ngokucacileyo indlela engaphambili kumgama ubuncinane oyi-150m.

Izibane zakho zangaphambili ezithotyiweyo zikhanyisa indlela kumgama ongaphezu kwe-45m phambi kwemoto yakho.

Kumgama oyi-100m usebenzisa izibane zangaphambili ezithotyiweyo.
Kumgama oyi-100m usebenzisa izibane zangaphambili eziphezulu.
Kumgama oyi-150m usebenzisa izibane zangaphambili eziphezulu.
Kufuneka ukwazi ukubona umntu, isithuthi okanye into enkulu esendleleni:
Kumgama ongadlulanga kwi-1m ukusuka kumda wendlela.
Kumgama ongaphezu kwe-12m ukusuka kwisibane sesitalato esikufutshane, ngaphandle kwendawo yokupaka ephawuliweyo kummandla wasedolophini.
Izibane zokupaka kufuneka zisetyenziswe xa upake:
Yeyiphi kwezi zilandelayo omele uyisebenzise xa uqhuba ukuba izibane zakho zangaphambili azisebenzi kwaye kusebusuku?
Izibane ezikhanyisa indawo ethile nezinokujikwa zinokusetyenziswa ngaba bantu balandelayo kwindlela kawonke-wonke:
Ukuba uhamba kuhola wendlela kwaye izibane zakho zeziqhoboshi azisebenzi, kufuneka usebenzise izibane zokulumkisa ngengozi.
Izibane zakho zangasemva kufuneka zikhanye ngakumbi kunezibane zakho zeziqhoboshi.
Zombini izibane zakho zeziqhoboshi kufuneka zisebenze ukuze usebenzise isithuthi sakho kwindlela kawonke-wonke.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.otherEquipment.text:
• Ivili lokuqhuba akufuneki libe nokujikeleza ngokukhululekileyo okugqithisileyo.
  • Oku kuthetha ukuba xa amavili ethe ngqo, akufuneki ukwazi ukujika ivili lokuqhuba ngaphezulu kwe-45 yeedigri phambi kokuba liqalise ukujika amavili aye ekhohlo okanye ekunene.

• Awuvumelekanga ukusebenzisa isithuthi esilula kwindlela kawonke-wonke ukuba asinaso isiqhoboshi sokusebenza (isiqhoboshi sonyawo) kunye nesiqhoboshi sokupaka (isiqhoboshi sesandla).
  • Kwisithuthi esilula, iziqhoboshi zokusebenza kufuneka zikwazi ukumisa imoto kumgama ongadlulanga kwi-14m ukuba ubuhamba ngesantya se-35km/h.
  • Isiqhoboshi sokupaka kufuneka sikwazi ukugcina imoto yakho ingashukumi, injini ingadityaniswanga namavili, kwithambeka elinokufikelela kwi-1:8.33.

Ezi ntlobo zilandelayo zezixhobo zokuthintela ubusela azivumelekanga ngokomthetho:

  • Isixhobo sokuthintela ubusela esikuvumela ukuba uqhawule ivili lokuqhuba kwinkqubo yokuqhuba imoto.

• Iglasi yeefestile neefestile zangaphambili kufuneka icoceke kwaye ingabi nazintanda ukuze ukwazi ukubona ngaphandle ngokucacileyo.
  • Naziphi na iifilim okanye izinto zokwenza iglasi ibe mnyama akufuneki zibe namaqamza okanye zikrazuke.
  • Awuvumelekanga ukusebenzisa imoto yakho kwindlela kawonke-wonke ngaphandle kokuba inesosuli sefestile yangaphambili esisebenzayo ubuncinane esinye (eso siphambi komqhubi ngqo).

• Izithuthi ezilula kufuneka zibe nesipili sangaphakathi ubuncinane esinye kunye nesangaphandle ubuncinane esinye (kwicala lomqhubi).
  • Iibhasi ezincinci, iibhasi neelori kufuneka zibe nesipili sangaphandle nakwicala lomkhweli.

• Kufuneka ube nocango ubuncinane olunye ngasekhohlo nolunye ngasekunene ezinokuvulwa zize zivalwe ngaphakathi nangaphandle.
  • Awuvumelekanga ukuqhuba iingcango zivuliwe.

• Isilinganisi-santya sakho kufuneka sisebenze kakuhle xa usebenzisa indlela kawonke-wonke.
• Imoto yakho kufuneka ikwazi ukuya phambili nokubuya umva xa usebenzisa indlela kawonke-wonke.

• Awuvumelekanga ukuqhuba ngesithulisi-sandi esonakeleyo.
  • Awuvumelekanga ukusebenzisa imoto yakho kwindlela kawonke-wonke ukuba umsi ophuma kumbhobho wokukhupha umsi uyaphazamisa okanye uthintela abanye abaqhubi ekuboneni.
Zeziphi kwezi zinto zilandelayo ezifunekayo ukuze imoto yakho ikulungele ukusetyenziswa endleleni?

Ukuqinisekisa ukuba umqhubi ubona ngokucacileyo, iiglasi zangaphambili azivumelekanga ukuba:

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.seatBelts.0.de.text:

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.transportingGo.text: Ukuthutha iimpahla

Iindawo ezisikekileyo ezingaphantsi kwe-10% yobubanzi betayara.
Akufuneki kubekho naziphi na ... ezibonakalayo kwitayara lakho:
(1) Imoto yakho ikulungele ukusetyenziswa endleleni ukuba uyayibona ipateni yemijelo ubuncinane kumatayara akho amathathu.
(2) Ungaqhuba ngamatayara anemisonto yangaphakathi ebonakalayo ukuba oku kukwitayara elinye kuphela kwaye uphethe itayara elisecaleni.
(3) Kufuneka ukwazi ukutshintsha itayara ukuze ufumane ilayisensi yakho yokuqhuba.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theCar.unauthorisedUs.text:
• Musa ukuqhuba, ukungena, ukukhwela phezu kwesithuthi okanye ukuphazamisana naso ngaphandle kwemvume yomntu ophethe isithuthi ngokusemthethweni.
  • Musa ukutshintsha inombolo yetshasi okanye yenjini yesithuthi ngaphandle kokubonisana negunya lobhaliso.
Zeziphi kwezi zilandelayo ongavumelekanga ukuzenza ngaphandle kwemvume yomntu ophethe isithuthi ngokusemthethweni?
Awuvumelekanga ukutshintsha ... yesithuthi ngaphandle kokubonisana nogunyaziwe wobhaliso.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theDriver.accidents.0.text:
• Misa ngoko nangoko
  • Fumanisa ukuba kukho umntu owenzakeleyo. Wenzakele kangakanani?
  • Fumanisa ukuba ngowuphi umonakalo obangelweyo
  • Ukuba akukho mntu wenzakeleyo, susa izithuthi ukuba zithintela indlela
  • Sebenzisa oonxantathu besilumkiso sikaxakeka ukuba kuyimfuneko
  • Tshintshiselanani ngolwazi oluninzi kangangoko kunokwenzeka:
    • Igama/idilesi/inombolo yesazisi yabo bonke abaqhubi ababandakanyekayo
    • Igama/idilesi/inombolo yesazisi yabanini bazo zonke izithuthi ezibandakanyekayo
    • Uhlobo/imodeli/umbala/inombolo yobhaliso yazo zonke izithuthi ezibandakanyekayo
    • Iinkcukacha zeenkampani ze-inshorensi zazo zonke izithuthi ezibandakanyekayo
    • Ukuba bekukho amangqina, thatha neenkcukacha zawo
  • Yiya kwisikhululo samapolisa zingaphelanga iiyure eziyi-24, uphethe ilayisenisi yakho, ukuze uxele ingozi (ngaphandle kokuba amapolisa ebekwindawo yengozi)
  • Musa ukusela utywala/ukusebenzisa iziyobisi ngaphambi kokuxela ingozi

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theDriver.accidents.1.text:
• Biza amapolisa ngoko nangoko
  • Biza iambulensi ukuba kuyimfuneko
  • Nceda abantu abenzakeleyo
  • Musa ukuhambisa izithuthi ngaphandle kokuba igosa lezendlela liyakuyalela, okanye ngaphandle kokuba ziyivale ngokupheleleyo indlela yezithuthi, kwaye kuphela emva kokuphawula ngokucacileyo indawo ebezikuyo endleleni. Zihambise kuphela kangangoko kuyimfuneko ukuze izithuthi zikwazi ukudlula.
  • Izithuthi azivumelekanga ukususwa kwindawo yengozi ngaphandle kwemvume yomqhubi, yomnini okanye yomntu ogunyazisiweyo
Ukuba kukho umntu owenzakeleyo okanye oswelekileyo kwindawo esedolophini

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theDriver.accidents.q.text: Ususe iimoto ngoko nangoko kuba abanye abaqhubi baya kube besondela ngesantya esiphezulu.
Ubeke unxantathu wesilumkiso sikaxakeka kumgama we-45m ukusuka kwisithuthi sakho, kwicala ezisondela kulo ezinye izithuthi.
Uqinisekise ukuba kukho nabani na owenzakeleyo.
Xa kukho ingozi ngaphandle kwendawo yasezidolophini, into yokuqala ekufuneka uyenze kukuba:
Ukuba omnye umqhubi ebephantsi kweempembelelo zeziyobisi okanye zotywala.
Uphawu lomenzi, imodeli nenombolo yobhaliso yesinye isithuthi.
Kufuneka kuvunyelwane ngokuba ngubani obangele ingozi.
Le nkcazelo ilandelayo kufuneka inikwe omnye nomnye kwindawo yengozi:
Akukho monakalo nakwesiphi na kwezi zithuthi zimbini.
Kuphakathi kokuphuma nokutshona kwelanga kwaye ukwindawo eyingozi.
Kusoloko kunyanzelekile ukuba ume.
Emva kokubandakanyeka kwingozi, akunyanzelekanga ukuba ume ukuba:
(1), (2) no-(3) ziyinyaniso.
Ngu-(2) no-(3) kuphela eziyinyaniso.
Ngu-(3) kuphela oyinyaniso.
Yeyiphi kwezi nkcazelo zilandelayo eyinyaniso?
(1) Umqhubi wesithuthi ngasinye kufuneka ancede abakhweli abakwisithuthi sakhe.
(2) Ungazisusa iimoto ngoko nangoko ukuba kukho umntu owenzakeleyo kwindawo esedolophini kwaye kubizwe iambulensi, ukuba nje akukho mntu uswelekileyo.

(3) Ukuba kukho umntu osweleke kwindawo esedolophini, awuvumelekanga ukuzisusa iimoto ngaphandle kokuba ziyivale ngokupheleleyo indlela yezithuthi, kwaye unokuzisusa kuphela emva kokuphawula ngokucacileyo iindawo ebezimi kuzo endleleni.
Kufuneka uqinisekise ukuba ngowuphi umonakalo owenzekileyo.
Kufuneka kubizwe amapolisa ngoko nangoko.
Akufanele usele utywala okanye uthathe iziyobisi kwiiyure ezingama-24 emva kwengozi.
Kuzo zonke iingozi:

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theDriver.alcoholDrug.text: Utywala neziyobisi

• Awuvumelekanga ukuqhuba okanye nokuhlala kwisihlalo somqhubi injini isebenza ukuba
    • Usebenzise iziyobisi ezidodobalisayo (kuquka namayeza amiselwe ngugqirha)
    • Ungumqhubi oqhelekileyo kwaye izinga lotywala egazini lakho lingaphezu kwe-0.05g kwi-100ml yegazi (0.24mg kwi-1000 ml yomoya owuphefumlela ngaphandle)
    • Ungumqhubi oqeqeshiweyo kwaye izinga lotywala egazini lakho lingaphezu kwe-0.02g kwi-100ml yegazi (0.10mg kwi-1000 ml yomoya owuphefumlela ngaphandle)
  • Ukuba igosa lokunyanzeliswa komthetho liyakucela, awuvumelekanga ukwala ukunika isampulu yegazi okanye yomoya owuphefumlela ngaphandle
  • Awuvumelekanga ukutshaya de isampulu ithathwe
  • Ngexesha leCD ishicilelwa, kwakukho isindululo sokwazisa imithetho emitsha eyenza kube kukwaphula umthetho ukuba abaqhubi babe nalo naluphi na utywala emizimbeni yabo kwiminyaka emithathu yokuqala emva kokufumana ilayisenisi yabo. Nceda ujonge ukuba lo mthetho sele uqalile ukusebenza na ngexesha ufumana ilayisenisi yakho.
Umthetho uthi

Ukuba abantu ababini basele umlinganiselo ofanayo wotywala, amazinga otywala egazini labo anokwahluka, ngoko akunakwenzeka ukuchaza ngokuthe ngqo ukuba bonke abantu bangasela kangakanani ukuze bahlale bengaphantsi komda. Ezinye zezinto ezichaphazela izinga lotywala egazini zezi:
  • Isini: ngokubanzi, izinga lotywala egazini lamadoda linyuka kancinci kunelabafazi
  • Ubunzima: okukhona ubunzima bakho buphantsi, kokukhona izinga lotywala egazini lakho linyuka ngokukhawuleza
  • Imeko yempilo ngokubanzi: ukuba uyagula, linyuka ngokukhawuleza
  • Isantya osele ngaso (ukusela kancinci kungcono)
  • Okunye okutyileyo okanye okuseleyo, okanye ezinye iziyobisi okanye amayeza owasebenzisileyo
Izinto ezichaphazela izinga lotywala egazini

• Njengoko kukhankanyiwe, akunakwenzeka ukuchaza ngokuthe ngqo ukuba zingaphi iziselo onokuzisela ngaphambi kokudlula kumda, kuba oko kuxhomekeke kwizinto ezininzi. Kungcono usele kancinci ukuze uqiniseke ukuba ungaphantsi komda. Kodwa ukuze ube nombono, kufuneka uhlale ungaphantsi kwezi zixa:
    • 1-2 iziselo kubafazi (ungaseli ngaphezu kwe-1 isiselo ngeyure)
    • 2-3 iziselo kumadoda (ungaseli ngaphezu kwe-1 isiselo ngeyure)
  • Utywala buthatha ixesha ukuqhekeka egazini lakho, ngoko ukuba ubusele kakhulu ebusuku waza awaqhuba, usenokuba ungaphezu komda xa uvuka ngentsasa elandelayo uze uqhube.
  • Emva kokuyeka ukusela, linda ubuncinane iyure ngesicelo ngasinye sotywala osiseleyo ukuze siqhekeke.
Izikhokelo ngokubanzi zokuhlala ungaphantsi komda

• Iglasi enye yewayini yetafile (125ml)
  • Itoti/ibhotile enye yebhiya (340ml)
  • Umlinganiselo omnye wotywala obuqinileyo (25ml)
Esinye 'isiselo' sesi
Kufuneka usoloko uphethe iphepha likagqirha elichaza amayeza omiselwe wona xa uqhuba.
Awuvumelekanga ukuqhuba kwaphela.
Awuvumelekanga ukuqhuba kangangeyure enye emva kokuthatha iziyobisi.
Xa uthathe iziyobisi ngokomyalelo kagqirha:
Ufanele uqhagamshelane negqwetha ukuze libe khona phambi kokuba unike isampulu.
Awuvumelekanga ukutshaya de ube uyinikile isampulu.
Ungala ukunika isampulu ukuba sele uyinikile enye kwiiyure ezingama-24 ezidlulileyo.
Ukuba igosa lezendlela likucela ukuba unike isampulu yegazi okanye yomoya owuphefumlela ngaphandle:
Umlinganiselo omnye omncinane wotywala obuqinileyo uphantse ulingane neebhiya ezimbini.
Iiyunithi ezimbini zotywala eziselwe kwisithuba seeyure ezimbini zingaphantsi komda ovumelekileyo kumadoda.
Ubungakanani botywala ekufuneka umntu abusele ukuze athathwe njengonxilileyo ngokomthetho buyahluka kumntu nomntu.
Ngokuphathelele amanqanaba otywala egazini:
0.2g kwi-100ml yegazi kubaqhubi abaqhuba njengomsebenzi.
0.05g kwi-100ml yegazi kubaqhubi abaqhelekileyo.
0.24g kwi-100ml yegazi kubaqhubi abaqhelekileyo.
EMzantsi Afrika, umda osemthethweni womlinganiselo wotywala egazini ngu:
Zonke ziyinyaniso.
Akukho nanye eyinyaniso.
Ngu-(3) kuphela oyinyaniso.
Yeyiphi kwezi zilandelayo eyinyaniso?
(1) Akuvumelekanga ukuba uhlale kwisihlalo somqhubi wemoto enenjini esebenzayo ukuba umlinganiselo wotywala egazini lakho ungaphezu komda osemthethweni.
(2) Ibhinqa elinobunzima obungaphantsi kobuqhelekileyo linokunxila ngokukhawuleza ngakumbi kunendoda enobunzima obungaphezu kobuqhelekileyo.
(3) Kusenokwenzeka ukuba umlinganiselo wotywala egazini lakho ube usengaphezu komda osemthethweni ngentsasa elandela ukusela kwakho utywala.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theDriver.cellphones..text:
• Awuvumelekanga ukuqhuba ubambe iselfowuni ngesandla okanye ngalo naliphi na elinye ilungu lomzimba wakho.
  • Sebenzisa ifowuni yemoto, iseti yeendlebe okanye isixhobo sokusebenzisa ifowuni ngaphandle kokuyibamba ngezandla.
  • Lo mthetho usebenza kuso nasiphi na isixhobo sonxibelelwano, ezifana neerediyo eziphathwa ngesandla.
  • Awusebenzi kubasebenzi beenkonzo zikaxakeka abasemsebenzini.
Kuphela ngabasebenzi beenkonzo zongxamiseko abangekho emsebenzini ngelo xesha.
Kuphela xa kusetyenziswa isixhobo esivumela ukuthetha ngaphandle kokubamba ifowuni ngezandla.
Ngabaqhubi abangakwaziyo ukusebenzisa iiselfowuni ngenxa yezithintelo zemithetho yendlela.
Ngamagosa ezendlela xa esenza imisebenzi yawo.
Izixhobo zonxibelelwano ezingezizo iiselfowuni, umzekelo oonomathotholo abaphathwa ngesandla, zingasetyenziswa:

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theDriver.driversDuti.text:
• Soloko usilawula isithuthi sakho
  • Qinisekisa ukuba uyibona ngokucacileyo indlela ephambi kwakho
  • Ifestile yangaphambili neyangasemva kunye nezipili zokujonga ngasemva kufuneka zicoceke kwaye zingaqhekeki
  • Buyisela isithuthi umva kuphela xa kukhuselekile, kwaye kumgama omfutshane kangangoko kunokwenzeka
  • Akukho lungu lomzimba wakho livumelekileyo ukuba libe ngaphandle kwesithuthi, ngaphandle kwaxa unika imiqondiso ngesandla
  • Suka kuphela xa kukhuselekile kwaye xa ungazi kuphazamisa ukuhamba kwezithuthi
  • Gcina umgama okhuselekileyo phakathi kwakho nesithuthi osilandelayo ukuze ukwazi ukumisa kwangethuba (imizuzwana eyi-2 ngumgama oqhelekileyo wokulandela)
  • Vulela indlela ngoko nangoko izithuthi zikaxakeka ezikhalisa iisayireni
  • Awuvumelekanga ukuyishiya injini isebenza ukuba
    • Isithuthi asikho phantsi kolawulo lwakho (ungaphandle kwemoto)
    • Isiciko setanki yamafutha sisusiwe
    • Imoto ikhupha umsi omninzi kakhulu
  • Ukuba uyayishiya imoto, kufuneka ubambe isiqhoboshi sokupaka
  • Imiyalelo yegosa lezendlela isoloko ibaluleke ngaphezu kwawo nawuphi na umthetho wendlela okanye uphawu lwendlela/uphawu oluphawulwe endleleni
  • Hlala ngasekhohlo kwiindlela ezihamba izithuthi kumacala omabini. Kwindlela ehamba izithuthi kwicala elinye, ungahamba ngasekunene
  • Phatha ilayisenisi yakho yokuqhuba ngalo lonke ixesha
  • Soloko uqhuba ucingela ukhuseleko lwabo bonke abantu nepropathi esendleleni nasecaleni kwayo.

• Musa ukuvumela abantu okanye izilwanyana zithintele ukubona kwakho okanye amandla akho okulawula isithuthi okanye okunika imiqondiso ngokucacileyo
  • Musa ukuvumela nabani na athathe ulawulo lwevili lokuqhuba okanye lwezixhobo zokulawula isithuthi
  • Umkhweli akavumelekanga ukuqhuba/ukujika ivili lokuqhuba isithuthi ngaphandle kokuba kucacile ukuba umqhubi akasakwazi ukusilawula isithuthi
  • Akukho mntu (okanye silwanyana) ovumelekileyo ukuba abe phezu kophahla/kwinyathelo lokukhwela/kwibhodi yokunyathela esecaleni xa isithuthi sihamba
  • Abakhweli abavumelekanga ukukhupha naliphi na ilungu lomzimba ngaphandle kwemoto
  • Qinisekisa ukuba abakhweli bayakwazi ukuvula nokuvala iingcango kunye nokukhulula amabhanti ezihlalo
  • Qinisekisa ukuba banxibe amabhanti ezihlalo
  • Musa ukubavumela bakhwele okanye behle xa isithuthi sihamba okanye xa kungakhuselekanga
  • Abakhweli bavumelekile ukukhwela ngasemva kwilori okanye kwiveni kuphela ukuba amacala ayo anobude obungekho ngaphantsi kwe-
    • 450mm xa behleli (350mm e-KZN)
    • 900mm xa bemi (1250mm e-KZN)
  • Lo mthetho ungasentla awusebenzi kubantu abathuthwa ngenxa yomsebenzi
  • Musa ukukhwelisa abakhweli abagqithisileyo. Umntu ngamnye kufuneka abe nendawo yokuhlala enobubanzi obungekho ngaphantsi kwe-380mm
Ukushiya isithuthi sakho singajongwanga injini isebenza.
Ukuqhuba ubuya umva kumgama ongaphezu kwe-120 meters.
Yindlela ekuqhutywa kuyo kwicala elinye kuphela.
Uvumelekile ukuqhuba kwicala lasekunene lendlela ukuba:
(1) Awuvumelekanga nangaliphi na ixesha ukukhuphela naliphi na ilungu lomzimba wakho ngaphandle kwesithuthi ngoxa uqhuba.
(2) Imiyalelo yegosa lezendlela isoloko ithatha indawo yokuqala ngaphezu kwazo naziphi na iimpawu, imiqondiso okanye imigca ephawulwe endleleni.
(3) Kufuneka unike indlela izithuthi zongxamiseko ezikhalisa iisiren ukuba zisondela zivela kwicala lakho lasekunene.
Xa upaka uze ushiye imoto yakho, kufuneka:
(1) Abaphosi nantoni na ngaphandle kwesithuthi ngoxa sihamba.
(2) Babopha amabhanti ezihlalo ukuba bangaphantsi kweminyaka eyi-14 okanye ubude babo bungaphantsi kwe-1.5m.
Ukuba umqhubi uziva egula, umkhweli okwisihlalo esingaphambili kufuneka athathe ulawulo lwevili lokuqhuba ngoko nangoko.
Abantu okanye izilwanyana abavumelekanga ukuba babe kwibhodi yokunyathela esecaleni kwemoto ngoxa ihamba.
Ilori ethutha abasebenzi basezifama kufuneka ibe namacala anobude obuyi-450mm ubuncinane ukuba bahleli.
Imoto yakho ilayishwe ngokugqithisileyo ukuba kukho umkhweli ongenayo indawo yokuhlala engange ... ubuncinane.
Uqinisekise ukuba zibotshelelwe ukuze zingakwazi ukuhambahamba ngaphakathi kwisithuthi.
Ungavumeli nantoni na ithintele indlela obona ngayo.
Ufake isicelo semvume efanelekileyo kwabasemagunyeni bengingqi yakho.
Xa uthutha izilwanyana ngaphakathi kwisithuthi esilula kufuneka:
Ulumkise abanye abaqhubi usebenzisa izibane zakho ezidanyazayo zesilumkiso sikaxakeka.
Xa usiva isayireni yesithuthi sikaxakeka kufuneka:

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theDriver.learnerDriv.text: Abaqhubi abasafundayo

Ukuba unelayisenisi yomfundi wokuqhuba, ungaqhuba imoto, kodwa kufuneka uthobele le mithetho ilandelayo:
  • Kufuneka uhlale unelayisenisi yakho yomfundi wokuqhuba kuwe ngalo lonke ixesha uqhuba
  • Kufuneka uhlale unomntu okujongileyo ngalo lonke ixesha, kwaye lowo mntu:
    • Kufuneka abe nelayisenisi esemthethweni yodidi olufanayo lwesithuthi
    • Kufuneka ahlale kwisihlalo somkhweli okanye emva kwesihlalo somqhubi ukuba akakwazi ukuhlala kwisihlalo somkhweli
    • Akavumelekanga ukuba abe phantsi kweempembelelo zeziyobisi okanye zotywala
  • Umthetho awukunyanzeli ukuba usebenzise iimpawu ezinoonobumba L, kodwa abanye abaqhubi badla ngokuba nomonde ngakumbi kuwe ukuba uyazisebenzisa (khumbula ukuzisusa emva kwesihlandlo ngasinye sokuqhuba)
  • Ungaba nabanye abakhweli emotweni, kodwa abavumelekanga abakhweli abahlawulayo
  • Ungaqhuba koohola bendlela.
Ilayisenisi yomfundi wokuqhuba indivumela ukuba ndenze ntoni?
Iinyanga eziyi-18 ukususela kumhla owaphumelela ngawo uvavanyo lwakho.
Ilayisenisi yomfundi wokuqhuba isebenza ixesha elingakanani?

• Kwizithuthi ezilula kufuneka ube neminyaka eyi-17 okanye ngaphezulu.
  • Akufuneki ukuba inkundla yomthetho ikuthintele ekufumaneni ilayisenisi yomfundi okanye ilayisenisi yokuqhuba.
  • Awuvumelekanga ukufaka isicelo ukuba ilayisenisi yakho inqunyanyisiwe kwaye ixesha lokunqunyanyiswa alikapheli, okanye ukuba ilayisenisi yakho inombhalo wesithintelo okanye irhoxisiwe.
  • Awuvumelekanga ukufaka isicelo ukuba sele unelayisenisi yodidi olunye lwesithuthi.
  • Akufuneki ube nokukhubazeka ngokwasemzimbeni okanye ngokwasengqondweni okunokwenza kube nzima okanye kube yingozi ukuba uqhube (kuquka isifo sokuxhuzula okanye isifo seswekile esingalawulwayo). Ukuba sele unelayisenisi kwaye ufumanisa ukuba unengxaki enjalo, luxanduva lwakho ukuyixela kwabasemagunyeni zingaphelanga iintsuku eziyi-21 emva kokuyifumanisa.
Iimfuneko zelayisenisi yomfundi wokuqhuba

• Awuvumelekanga ukuba nelayisenisi yomfundi ngaphandle kokuba umlinganiselo wakho wokubona ngokuvavanywa ngeSnellen ngu-
    • 6/12 (20/40) kwiliso ngalinye
    • okanye ukuba umlinganiselo weliso elinye ungaphantsi kwe-6/12, elinye iliso kufuneka libe ku-6/9 (20/30)
  • Ungalwenza uvavanyo lwamehlo unxibe iindondo okanye iilensi ezifakwa emehlweni. Ukuba wenjenjalo, ilayisenisi yakho iya kuba nombhalo wesithintelo kwaye kuya kufuneka unxibe iindondo okanye iilensi zakho ngalo lonke ixesha uqhuba.
  • Ukuba awuluphumeleli uvavanyo lwamehlo kwisebe lezendlela, ungaya kuvavanywa kwakhona yingcali yamehlo ebhalisiweyo. Ukuba uyaluphumelela uvavanyo lwayo, isebe lezendlela kufuneka lisamkele eso siphumo.
Ukubona

• Yiya ngokwakho kwiziko lovavanyo lwelayisenisi yomfundi ukuze ubhukishe uvavanyo lwakho.
  • Phatha imali emiselweyo. Iyahluka ngokwamaphondo, ngoko qhagamshelana neziko lakho lovavanyo ukuze ufumanise ukuba yimalini.
  • Phatha incwadi yakho yesazisi esemthethweni.
  • Phatha iifoto ezimbini zesazisi (zinokuba zezemibala okanye ezimnyama nezimhlophe).
  • Kwiziko lovavanyo uya kugcwalisa iFomu LL1.
  • Amehlo akho aya kuvavanywa kwiziko lovavanyo.
  • Uya kunikwa umhla wokubuya ukuze wenze uvavanyo lwakho.
Ukubhukisha uvavanyo lwelayisenisi yomfundi

• Uvavanyo lwelayisenisi yakho yomfundi luvavanyo olubhaliweyo lwethiyori olugubungela amacandelo amathathu aphambili:
    • Imithetho yendlela, iimpawu zokulawula izithuthi kunye nemigaqo yokuqhuba ngononophelo ukuthintela iingozi
    • Iimpawu zendlela kunye nemigca nezinye iimpawu eziphawulwe endleleni
    • Izixhobo zokulawula isithuthi
  • Yonke imibuzo ineempendulo onokukhetha kuzo.
  • Kufuneka uqhube kakuhle kuwo omathathu amacandelo. Nokuba amanqaku akho ewonke aphezulu, ungasilela ukuba awuqhubanga kakuhle kwelinye lamacandelo.
  • Uya kufumana incwadana yovavanyo enemibuzo kunye nencwadana yemizobo enemifanekiso, umzekelo iimpawu zendlela kunye neemeko zasendleleni. Eminye imibuzo yovavanyo ibhekisa kwimifanekiso ekwincwadana yemizobo.
Uvavanywa njani?
Ukhwelise abakhweli emotweni yakho.
Uqhube ngesantya esingaphezu kwe-100km/h.
Uqhube ungaliphethe iphepha-mvume lakho.
Xa unephepha-mvume lokufunda ukuqhuba kuphela, awuvumelekanga ukuba:
Uqhube kuphela xa ukhatshwa ngumntu okubek' esweni onelayisenisi yodidi lwesithuthi osiqhubayo.
Ungaqhubi koohola bendlela.
Ufake isicelo selayisenisi yokuqhuba kwiinyanga eziyi-12.
Wakuba unelayisenisi yokufundela ukuqhuba, kufuneka:
Ungaphezulu kweminyaka eyi-17 ubudala
Sele unelayisenisi yodidi olufanayo lwesithuthi.
Unxiba iindondo.
Awuvumelekanga ukuba ufumane ilayisenisi yokufundela ukuqhuba ukuba:
Akukho nanye kuzo eyinyaniso.
Ngu-(2) no-(3) kuphela abayinyaniso.
Ngu-(3) kuphela oyinyaniso.
Zeziphi kwezi nkcazelo zilandelayo eziyinyaniso?
(1) Ukuba unxiba iindondo, akuyi kufuneka wenze uvavanyo lwamehlo xa ufaka isicelo selayisenisi yokufundela ukuqhuba.
(2) Ukuba inkundla yomthetho ikuthintele ekubeni ube nelayisenisi yokuqhuba, kufuneka uphinde ufake isicelo selayisenisi yokufundela ukuqhuba uze ubhale uvavanyo lwakho kwakhona.
(3) Ungarhuqa ikharavani okanye inqwelo erhuqwayo ukuba unelayisenisi yokufundela ukuqhuba kuphela.
Ngu-(1) kuphela oyimpendulo echanekileyo
Ngu-(1) no-(2) kuphela abaziimpendulo ezichanekileyo
U-(1), u-(2) no-(3) bonke bachanekile
Ungafumana ilayisenisi yokufundela ukuqhuba kuphela ukuba:
(1) Ilayisenisi yakho ayinqunyanyiswanga, okanye ixesha lokunqunyanyiswa kwayo liphelile.
(2) Awukabinayo ilayisenisi yodidi olufanayo lwesithuthi.
(3) Awunako nakuphi na ukukhubazeka emzimbeni okanye engqondweni okunokwenza ukuba kungakhuseleki xa uqhuba.
Iimpawu zendlela, Imiqondiso yokulawula izithuthi, Iimpawu ezipeyintwe endleleni.
Imithetho yendlela, Iimpawu zendlela/iimpawu ezipeyintwe endleleni, Izixhobo zokulawula isithuthi.
Ukuqhuba ngononophelo ukuthintela iingozi, Iinkqubo ze-K53, Iimpawu zendlela/imiqondiso yokulawula izithuthi.
Uvavanyo lwelayisenisi yomfundi lunala macandelo mathathu alandelayo:
Ngu-(1) no-(2) kuphela abayinyaniso.
Ngu-(2) no-(3) kuphela abayinyaniso.
Ngu-(1) no-(3) kuphela abayinyaniso.
Zeziphi kwezi zilandelayo eziyinyaniso?
(1) Uvavanyo lwelayisenisi yomfundi lunemibuzo yokukhetha impendulo kuphela.
(2) Eminye imibuzo kuvavanyo ibhekisa kwimizobo nakwimifanekiso ekwincwadana yemizobo.
(3) Uvavanyo lwelayisenisi yomfundi lunecandelo elibhaliweyo kunye necandelo lokuqhuba.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theRoad.damageToPubli.text:
• Awuvumelekanga ukuthintela okanye ukuphazamisa ukuhamba kwezithuthi kwindlela kawonke-wonke.
  • Awuvumelekanga ukubeka nantoni na endleleni enokwenza oko.

Kufuneka ufumane imvume ebhaliweyo kwabasemagunyeni bephondo ngaphambi kokulungiselela okanye ukuthatha inxaxheba kuyo nayiphi na kwezi zinto zilandelayo kwindlela kawonke-wonke:
  • Umdyarho
  • Uvavanyo lwesantya/lokuthembeka kwesithuthi
  • Indibano yemidlalo
  • Nawuphi na umsebenzi onokuphazamisa okanye ubeke emngciphekweni ukuhamba kwezithuthi okuqhelekileyo

• Awuvumelekanga ukurhuqa amavili okanye ukuwajikelezisa endaweni enye.
  • Awuvumelekanga ukusebenzisa izithinteli zamavili okanye izihlangu zamavili phakathi kwamavili akho nendlela.
  • Awuvumelekanga ukonakalisa umphezulu wendlela nangayiphi na indlela.
  • Awuvumelekanga ukuhambisa isithuthi kwindledlana yabahambi ngeenyawo (nokuba uyasityhala okanye uyasitsala).
  • Musa ukubeka amafutha esithuthi, ioli okanye nayiphi na into engamkelekanga endleleni, ecaleni kwendlela okanye emanzini aqukuqelayo.
  • Musa ukurhuqa nantoni na kumphezulu wendlela enokuwonakalisa okanye ibangele ingozi okanye umonakalo kubasebenzisi bendlela.

• Awuvumelekanga ukusebenzisa okanye ukumisa isibane okanye isixhobo sokukhanyisa esibonakalayo kwindlela kawonke-wonke ngendlela ebeka ukhuseleko emngciphekweni.
  • Lo mgaqo ubhekisa kwizibane ezibekwe ecaleni kweendlela, hayi kwizibane zezithuthi.
Ukulandela ezinye iimoto ngokusondele kakhulu ngasemva kwazo.
Ukuthintela ukuhamba kwezithuthi akuvumelekanga. Ukuthintela ukuhamba kwezithuthi kuthetha:
Uthatha inxaxheba ekufotweni kwefilimu kummandla wasezidolophini.
Ukubeka iikhowuni zendlela endleleni ukuthintela izithuthi ukuba zingangeni kwinxalenye yendlela kuvumelekile kuphela xa:
Yeyiphi kwezi zilandelayo ofuna imvume esemthethweni ukuze uyiququzelele kwindlela kawonke-wonke?
Ungakwenza oko kuphela phambi kwepropati yakho okanye oyiqeshileyo.
Ungasisa isithuthi kwindledlana yabahambi ngeenyawo kuphela kangangexesha olithathayo ukuthula iimpahla kunye/okanye ukwehlisa abakhweli.
Awuvumelekanga ukuqhuba isithuthi kwindledlana yabahambi ngeenyawo nanini na.
Ngokuphathelele ukupaka isithuthi sakho kwindledlana yabahambi ngeenyawo:
Ukutsala amavili akho okanye ukuwajikelezisa endaweni enye.
Ukonakalisa iindlela zikawonke-wonke akuvumelekanga. Oku kuquka:
(1) Ukudlala umculo ongxolayo ukuba indlu yakho ikumgama ongaphantsi kwe-10m ukusuka kwindlela enkulu apho ingxolo inokuphazamisa abaqhubi.
(2) Ukufaka isibane esiqaqambileyo ngaphandle kwendlu yakho esinokuphazamisa abaqhubi.
(3) Ukugalela ioli esetyenzisiweyo ephuma kwinjini yemoto yakho kwindlela kawonke-wonke.
Izithinteli zamavili okanye izihlangu zamavili azivumelekanga ukuba zisetyenziswe kuba:
Kukweyiphi indawo apho ukugalela amafutha ezithuthi kululwaphulo-mthetho lwendlela?

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theRoad.freeways.0.de.text:
• Izithuthi ezitsalwa zizilwanyana
  • Iitrektara (ngaphandle kwezisetyenziselwa ukwakha/ ukulungisa iindlela)
  • Izithuthi eziqhutywa ngeepedali (iibhayisekile, ezinamavili amathathu, ezinamavili amane)
  • Izithuthuthu eziqhutywa ngombane
  • Izithuthuthu ezinomthamo wenjini ongaphantsi kwe-50cc
  • Izithuthi ezinamavili amathathu/amane eziqhutywa yinjini
  • Izithuthi ezinobunzima obungaphantsi kwe-230 kg (ubukhulu becala izithuthi zabantu abakhubazekileyo)

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theRoad.freeways.1.de.text:
• Ukusebenzisa imiqondiso yezandla (ngaphandle kweemeko ezingxamisekileyo)
  • Ukuhlehla ngesithuthi
  • Ukuqhuba unqumle izahluli zendlela okanye iziqithi zendlela
  • Ukushiya izilwanyana ngasemva okanye ukuzivumela ukuba zibe kuhola wendlela
  • Awuvumelekanga ukuba uhambe ngeenyawo, okanye umise isithuthi sakho, ngaphandle kwezi meko:
    • Ukuthobela uphawu lwendlela okanye umyalelo wegosa lezendlela
    • Kwindawo ephawulwe njengeyokumisa/yokupaka
    • Ngenxa yesizathu esingaphaya kolawulo lwakho
    • Ulilungu loMkhosi waBemi kwaye ukwicala lasekhohlo lohola wendlela, phakathi kwendlela ephuma kuhola nendlela engena kuhola
    • Ukukhwelisa okanye ukwehlisa ilungu loMkhosi waBemi kwindawo echazwe ngasentla
    • Abasebenzi beenkonzo ezingxamisekileyo namaqela okulungisa iindlela abasemsebenzini bavumelekile ukumisa izithuthi nokuhamba ngeenyawo koohola bendlela

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theRoad.freeways.ques.text: Iilori ezinobunzima obupheleleyo besithuthi obungaphezu kwe-8 000kg.
Zeziphi kwezi zilandelayo ezivumelekileyo koohola bendlela?
Logama nje ukude ubuncinane nge-1m kumgca osecaleni kwendlela.
Kuphela xa ukhwelisa ilungu loMkhosi waBemi.
Uvumelekile ukuba uqhube ubuya umva kuhola wendlela:
Zeziphi kwezi zilandelayo ezivumelekileyo koohola bendlela?
(1) Izithuthuthu ezinomthamo we-injini ophakathi kwe-25cc ne-50cc.
(2) Izithuthuthu ezinomthamo we-injini ophakathi kwe-50cc ne-75cc.
(3) Izithuthuthu ezinomthamo we-injini ophakathi kwe-75cc ne-100cc.
Ukuba izilwanyana zilawulwa ngumqhubi ngeentambo zokuzikhokela.
Izithuthi ezitsalwa zizilwanyana zivumelekile koohola bendlela:
Iitrektara ezisetyenziselwa ukulungisa okanye ukwakha iindlela.
Phantsi kweemeko eziqhelekileyo kuhola wendlela, awuvumelekanga ukuba:
Abasebenzi basezifama, okanye abantu abaya emsebenzini.
Aba bantu balandelayo bavumelekile ukuba bahambe ngeenyawo kuhola wendlela:
Kwenzeke ingozi kwelinye icala kwaye kufuneka uye kunceda.
Uphoswe yindawo yakho yokuphuma kwaye akukho enye kumgama oyi-10km.
Ungaqhuba unqumle isahluli sendlela esiqinileyo okanye isiqithi sendlela kuhola wendlela kuphela kwezi meko zilandelayo:
Akukho meko apho uvumelekileyo ukuba ume kuhola wendlela.
Xa uyalelwe ligosa elilawula izithuthi ukuba wenze njalo.
Nangaliphi na ixesha ngaphandle kwempelaveki yePasika noSuku lweKrisimesi/uSuku lweNceba.
Uvumelekile ukuba ume kuhola wendlela phantsi kweziphi iimeko?
Izilwanyana zivumelekile kuhola wendlela kuphela xa:
(2) Ziqhutywa ukusuka kwenye indawo ukuya kwenye.

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theRoad.peopleOnTheRo.text: Abantu abasendleleni

Ngaphandle kokuba ukwindawo ephawulwe yaza yabekelwa oko, awuvumelekanga ukuthengisa okanye ukubonisa izinto ezithengiswayo kwindlela kawonke-wonke okanye ecaleni kwayo:
  • Kwindawo esedolophini:
    • Hayi kumgama ongaphantsi kwe-180m ukusuka kwindawo apho indlela inqumla khona umzila kaloliwe kwinqanaba elinye
    • Hayi kumgama ongaphantsi kwe-180m ukusuka kuphawu lwendlela olulumkisa ngegophe okanye ukunyuka kwendlela okusitha okungaphambili
    • Hayi kumgama ongaphantsi kwe-5m ukusuka kwisiphambuka
  • Akuvumelekanga kwaphela ngaphandle kwendawo esedolophini
Ukuthengisa kwiindlela zikawonke-wonke

• Ukuba indawo yokuwela yabahambi ngeenyawo ilawulwa zizibane zendlela, abahambi ngeenyawo kufuneka bathobele izibane (abavumelekanga ukuwela ngaphandle kokuba izibane ziyabavumela).
  • Ukuba ayilawulwa zizibane, abahambi ngeenyawo banelungelo lokudlula kuqala kwaye iimoto kufuneka zibamisele.
  • Abahambi ngeenyawo abavumelekanga ukungena ngesiquphe kwindawo yokuwela baze benze kube nzima ukuba iimoto zime ngokukhuselekileyo.
  • Abaqhubi kufuneka bame okanye banciphise isantya ukuba kukho abahambi ngeenyawo kwindawo yokuwela okanye abangena kuyo besuka kwicala elinye nelomqhubi.
  • Ayikho enye imoto evumelekileyo ukudlula isithuthi esime kwindawo yokuwela yabahambi ngeenyawo.
Iindawo zokuwela zabahambi ngeenyawo

• Ukuba kukho indledlana yabahambi ngeenyawo, abahambi ngeenyawo abavumelekanga ukuhamba endleleni, ngaphandle kokuyiwela.
  • Ukuba akukho ndledlana yabahambi ngeenyawo, abahambi ngeenyawo kufuneka bahambe bejongene nezithuthi ezizayo, kufutshane kangangoko kunokwenzeka nomphetho wasekunene wendlela.
  • Abahambi ngeenyawo bavumelekile ukuwela indlela kuphela emva kokuqinisekisa ukuba kukhuselekile, baze bayiwele ngokukhawuleza kangangoko kunokwenzeka.
  • Kufuneka bawele kwindawo yokuwela yabahambi ngeenyawo okanye kwisiphambuka, okanye kumgama ongekho ngaphantsi kwe-50m ukusuka kwezo ndawo.
Imisebenzi yabahambi ngeenyawo

• Kufuneka uhlale esihlalweni sebhayisekile, umlenze ube kwicala ngalinye.
  • Kufuneka uhlale ubambe izibambo ubuncinane ngesandla esinye.
  • Awuvumelekanga ukuba nomnye umntu, isilwanyana okanye into kwibhayisekile ethintela ukubona kwakho okanye ukulawula kwakho ibhayisekile.
  • Onke amavili kufuneka ahlale echukumisa indlela ngalo lonke ixesha.
  • Awuvumelekanga ukubambelela nakwesiphi na esinye isithuthi esihambayo.
  • Kufuneka nikhwele nilandelelana, ngaphandle kwaxa udlula omnye umkhweli webhayisekile; ngumntu omnye kuphela ovumelekileyo ukudlula ngexesha.
  • Awuvumelekanga ukwenza omnye umkhweli webhayisekile ajike ngesiquphe ukusuka kwelinye icala ukuya kwelinye.
  • Ukuba kukho inxalenye yendlela ebekelwe ukusetyenziswa ngabakhweli beebhayisekile, kufuneka usebenzise loo nxalenye, kwaye awuvumelekanga ukusebenzisa enye.
Imisebenzi yabakhweli beebhayisekile

• Izilwanyana azivumelekanga ukuba kwindlela kawonke-wonke kwindawo ebiyelweyo/evalelweyo kumacala omabini, ngaphandle kokuba:
    • ziyakhwelwa
    • zisetyenziselwa ukutsala isithuthi
    • ziqhutyelwa kwenye indawo
  • Ukuba uqhuba imfuyo, kufuneka uphathe:
    • Iflegi ebomvu esisikwere enamacala angama-300mm emini
    • Isibane esibomvu esibonakala kumgama we-150m ebusuku
  • Ukuba umhlambi unezilwanyana ezingaphantsi kwe-10, iflegi/isibane esinye sanele.
  • Ukuba umhlambi unezilwanyana ezingaphezu kwe-10, izilumkiso zakho kufuneka zithwalwe ngaphambili nangasemva komhlambi.
  • Akukho zilwanyana zivumelekileyo koohola bendlela.
Ukuqhuba imfuyo
Kumgama ongaphantsi kwe-5m ukusuka kwinxalenye yendlela ehamba izithuthi ngaphandle kwendawo yasezidolophini.
Kumgama ongaphantsi kwe-5m ukusuka kwindawo apho indlela inqumla umzila kaloliwe kwinqanaba elinye okanye kwikona ongakwaziyo ukubona ngaphaya kwayo kwindawo yasezidolophini.
Kumgama ongaphantsi kwe-5m ukusuka kwisiphambuka kwindawo yasezidolophini.
Akuvumelekanga ukuba uthengise okanye ubonise iimpahla kwindlela kawonke-wonke okanye ecaleni kwayo:
Kwindawo yokuwela yabahambi ngeenyawo elawulwayo, abahambi ngeenyawo banokuwela nanini na ukuba akukho zimoto zisondelayo.
Kwindawo yokuwela yabahambi ngeenyawo engalawulwayo, abaqhubi kufuneka banciphise isantya okanye bame ukuba kukho abahambi ngeenyawo abakwindawo yokuwela okanye abangena kuyo.
Kwindawo yokuwela yabahambi ngeenyawo engalawulwayo, iimoto zinelungelo lokuhamba kuqala.
Ngokuphathelele kwiindawo zokuwela zabahambi ngeenyawo:
Ngu-(1) no-(2) kuphela abakukwaphulwa komthetho.
Ngu-(3) kuphela okukukwaphulwa komthetho.
Akukho nanye kwezi ekukwaphulwa komthetho.
Zeziphi kwezi zilandelayo ezikukwaphulwa komthetho:
(1) Ukuthutha izilwanyana ngesithuthi esilula.
(2) Ukuqhuba izithuthi ezitsalwa zizilwanyana kwimimandla yasezidolophini.
(3) Ukuqhuba umhlambi wezilwanyana kwindlela kawonke-wonke.
Ukuba kukho indledlana yabahambi ngeenyawo, abahambi ngeenyawo kufuneka bahambe bejongene nezithuthi ezizayo.
Kwindawo yokuwela yabahambi ngeenyawo engalawulwayo, abahambi ngeenyawo abavumelekanga ukuba bangene ngequbuliso.
Abahambi ngeenyawo bavumelekile ukuwela indlela kuphela kwindawo ekudibana kuyo iindlela, okanye kumgama ongaphakathi kwe-50m ukusuka kuyo.
Imisebenzi yabahambi ngeenyawo iquka oku:
(1), (2) no-(3) zonke ziyinyani.
Ngu-(1) no-(3) kuphela abayinyani.
Ngu-(3) kuphela oyinyani.
Yeyiphi kwezi zilandelayo eyinyani:
(1) Ukuba akukho ndledlana yabahambi ngeenyawo, abahambi ngeenyawo kufuneka bahambe kufutshane kangangoko kunokwenzeka nomphetho wasekunene wendlela.
(2) Abahambi ngeenyawo bavumelekile ukuwela indlela kumgama we-180m ukusuka kwindawo ekudibana kuyo iindlela.
(3) Kwindawo yokuwela yabahambi ngeenyawo elawulwayo, abahambi ngeenyawo kufuneka bathobele iirobhothi nokuba akukho zithuthi endleleni.
Banxibe izinto ezibuyisa ukukhanya xa besendleleni kawonke-wonke phakathi kokutshona nokuphuma kwelanga.
Baqinisekise ukuba bahamba kuphela kwiindawo ezimiselwe abahambi ngeenyawo kuphela.
Baqinisekise ukuba kukhuselekile ukuwela indlela ngaphambi kokuyiwela ngokukhawuleza kangangoko kunokwenzeka.
Abahambi ngeenyawo kufuneka:
Bakhwele xa naliphi na ivili lingachukumisi indlela.
Bathwale izilwanyana kwiibhayisekile zabo eziqhutywa ngeepedali.
Bakhwele emgceni wabakhweli beebhayisekile abangaphezu kwesibini belandelana.
Abakhweli beebhayisekile abavumelekanga ukuba:
Abonise injongo yakhe ngokucacileyo nangexesha elifanelekileyo.
Aqinisekise ukuba mnye kuphela umkhweli webhayisekile ogqitha kumntu omnye ngexesha.
Agcine isithuba esivulekileyo esingekho ngaphantsi kwe-1.5m phakathi kweebhayisekile ezimbini eziqhutywa ngeepedali.
Xa egqitha komnye umkhweli webhayisekile, umkhweli webhayisekile kufuneka:
Ngamaxesha okuxinana kwezithuthi kusasa nangokuhlwa.
Ziimoto ezithutha iibhayisekile.
Ngabakhweli beebhayisekile ngawo onke amaxesha.
Ukuba kukho inxalenye yendlela ebekelwe abakhweli beebhayisekile, kufuneka isetyenziswe:
Zonke ezi ngxelo ziyinyaniso.
Akukho nanye kwezi ngxelo eyinyaniso.
Ngu-(1) kuphela oyinyaniso.
Xa uqhuba umhlambi wezilwanyana kwindlela kawonke-wonke:
(1) Kufuneka uphathe iflegi ebomvu (esisikwere esingu-30mm) emini.
(2) Ukuba umhlambi unezilwanyana ezingaphezu kwe-50, kufuneka uphathe isibane esibomvu ngasemva komhlambi ngexesha eliphakathi kokutshona kwelanga nokuphuma kwalo.
(3) Xa uqhuba umhlambi wezilwanyana kuhola wendlela, kufuneka uphathe iiflegi ezibomvu kumgama oyi-150m ngaphambili nangasemva komhlambi.
Zikhwelwe ngabantu.
Zinethegi echaza umnini wazo.
Zikumgama ongadlulanga kwi-180m ukusuka kwiipropati zomnini wazo.
Izilwanyana zinokuvunyelwa ukuba kwindlela kawonke-wonke kummandla wasezidolophini ukuba:

nav.rulesOfTheRoad.theRoad.vehiclesOnThe.text:
• Zonke izithuthi ezitsalwa zizilwanyana kwiindlela zikawonke-wonke kufuneka zibhalwe ngokucacileyo igama nedilesi yomnini.
  • Isithuthi nezixhobo zokubopha isilwanyana kufuneka zibe kwimeko ekhuselekileyo yokusebenza.
  • Isilwanyana nesithuthi kufuneka zihlale ziphantsi kolawulo lomntu (oqhuba ngeentambo okanye okhokela isilwanyana) ngaphandle kokuba zibotshiwe ukuze zingakwazi ukuhamba.
  • Izithuthi ezibini ezitsalwa zizilwanyana nezihamba kwicala elinye azivumelekanga ukuba zisondelelane kumgama ongaphantsi kwe-150m, ngaphandle kokuba esinye sidlula esinye kwaye siza kukhawuleza sisuke kuso.

• Isithuthi sithathwa njengesilahliweyo ukuba:
    • Sipakwe kwindawo ekungavumelekanga ukuma okanye ukupaka kuyo
    • Sishiywe singashukumi kwindawo enye kwindlela kawonke-wonke okanye kwisikhululo sovavanyo ixesha elingaphezu kweentsuku ezi-7 (kwindawo esedolophini)
    • Sishiywe kwindawo enye kwindlela kawonke-wonke ixesha elingaphezu kweeyure ezingama-24 (ngaphandle kwendawo esedolophini)
    • Asinayo ipleyiti yenombolo yobhaliso okanye sinepleyiti yobuxoki
