nav.vehicleControls.0.description.text:
• Ipedali yesantya Cinezela ipedali yesantya ukuze isithuthi sihambe. Ukuba ukwigiya yokubuya umva, uza kubuya umva; ukuba ukwenye yeegiya eziseleyo, uza kuhamba uye phambili. Okukhona uyicinezela, kokukhona uza kuhamba ngesantya esiphezulu. Ipedali yesantya kufuneka icinezelwe ngonyawo lwasekunene kuphela. Iklatshi nayo kufuneka ibambane (ipedali yayo ingacinezelwanga) ukuze imoto ihambe iye phambili.
  • Ipedali yesiqhoboshi Esi siqhoboshi saziwa njengesiqhoboshi senkonzo, okanye isiqhoboshi sonyawo. Cinezela ipedali yesiqhoboshi ukuze uthobe isantya sesithuthi okanye umise. Ipedali yesiqhoboshi kufuneka icinezelwe ngonyawo lwasekunene kuphela.
  • Ipedali yeklatshi Cinezela ipedali yeklatshi xa utshintsha iigiya. Ipedali yeklatshi kufuneka icinezelwe ngonyawo lwasekhohlo kuphela. Xa ungayisebenzisi, kufuneka ubeke unyawo lwakho lwasekhohlo emgangathweni ngasekhohlo kweklatshi, ungalubeki kwipedali yeklatshi. Izithuthi ezizitshintshayo iigiya azinayo ipedali yeklatshi.
  • Intonga yegiya Sebenzisa intonga yegiya ukukhetha okanye ukutshintsha iigiya. Ipedali yeklatshi kufuneka icinezelwe xa utshintsha iigiya. Ukubuya umva nako kunegiya yako, kwaye kufuneka ukuloo giya xa ufuna ukubuya umva. Ukhetha iigiya ngokwesantya ohamba ngaso. Xa uqala ukuhamba, kufuneka ube kwigiya yokuqala. Emva koko, ngokuqhelekileyo, okukhona uhamba ngesantya esiphezulu, kokukhona kufuneka usebenzise igiya ephezulu. Kufuneka usebenzise igiya esezantsi xa usihla induli kwaye ungafuni ukuba isithuthi sinyuse isantya kakhulu, okanye xa ufuna amandla angakumbi (umzekelo xa unyuka induli). Xa imoto yakho imile, kufuneka uyibeke kwinyutrali.
  • Isiqhoboshi sokupaka Esi siqhoboshi sikwabizwa ngokuba sisiqhoboshi sesandla. Tsala isiqhoboshi sokupaka usinyuse ukuze isithuthi sihlale simile xa umisile okanye xa ushiya imoto. Sihlise kwakhona ngaphambi kokuba uqale ukuhamba. Kufuneka usebenzise isiqhoboshi sokupaka kuphela emva kokuba isithuthi sime ngokupheleleyo, ungasisebenzisi xa sisahamba. Sebenzisa iqhosha lokukhulula isitshixo sesiqhoboshi (iqhosha elisekupheleni kwesiqhoboshi sokupaka) xa usinyusa okanye usihlisa.
  • Isalathisi sendlela Intonga yesalathisi sendlela ilayita izibane zesalathisi ezingaphandle kwemoto yakho. Inokuba kwelinye icala levili lokuqhuba ngokuxhomekeke kuhlobo lwemoto. Tyhala intonga uye phezulu okanye ezantsi (kwicala oza kujikela kulo ivili lokuqhuba) ukuze ubonise abanye abaqhubi ukuba ufuna ukuya okanye ukujika ngasekhohlo okanye ngasekunene. Buyisela intonga embindini ukuze ucime isalathisi xa ugqibile ukujika (amaxesha amaninzi isalathisi siyazicima). Kwiimoto ezininzi, izixhobo zokulayita nokucima izibane zangaphambili nezokutshintsha phakathi kwezibane ezikhanyisa kude nezibane ezithotyiweyo nazo zikule ntonga.
  • Isipili sokujonga ngasemva Esi sisipili sokujonga ngasemva, okanye isipili sangaphakathi. Jonga esipilini ukuze uqinisekise ukuba kukhuselekile ngasemva kwesithuthi sakho. Kufuneka ujonge kwisipili sokujonga ngasemva rhoqo emva kwemizuzwana eyi-5-8 xa uqhuba, nangalo lonke ixesha ngaphambi kokuba uqhoboshe okanye wenze umqondiso.
  • Isipili esisecaleni Esi sisipili sangaphandle, okanye isipili esisecaleni. Iimoto ezininzi zinezipili zangaphandle kwicala lomqhubi nakwicala lomkhweli. Jonga ezipilini ukuze uqinisekise ukuba kukhuselekile ngasemva kwesithuthi sakho. Ungajonga kwezi zipili rhoqo emva kwemizuzwana eyi-5-8 xa uqhuba, ngexesha ojonga ngalo kwisipili esiphambili sokujonga ngasemva, kodwa kufuneka uzijonge ngokukodwa xa utshintsha icala oya ngakulo (jonga kwisipili esikwicala ofuna ukujikela kulo). Qaphela ukuba kukho iindawo ezisecaleni kwemoto yakho ongakwaziyo ukuzibona kwezi zipili. Ezi zibizwa ngokuba ziindawo ezingabonakaliyo, kwaye kufuneka uzijonge ngokujika intloko ujonge ngasemva ngeefestile.
  • Isilinganisi-santya Isilinganisi-santya sikubonisa isantya ohamba ngaso. Sijonge ngamaxesha athile ukuze uqinisekise ukuba awugqithi kumda wesantya. Isilinganisi-santya sidla ngokubonisa nomgama ohanjiweyo, oko kukuthi umgama uwonke osele uhanjwe yimoto.
  • Ivili lokuqhuba Jika ivili lokuqhuba ukuze utshintshe icala oya ngakulo. Xa uqhuba, gcina izandla zombini kwivili lokuqhuba, ngaphandle kwaxa utshintsha iigiya okanye unika imiqondiso ngesandla. Ngala maxesha kufuneka uhlale ugcine ubuncinane isandla esinye kwivili lokuqhuba, uze ubuyisele esinye ngokukhawuleza kangangoko unako. Ukuba ivili lokuqhuba beliyiwotshi, ubuya kubeka isandla sakho sasekhohlo ku-10 nesandla sakho sasekunene ku-2.
  • Isilinganisi sobushushu/seoli Izilinganisi zikunika ulwazi ngenjini yakho. Iimoto ezininzi zinesilinganisi sobushushu esikuxelela ukuba injini ishushu kangakanani, isilinganisi seoli okanye isibane sesilumkiso esikuxelela xa ioli iphantsi, isilinganisi sepetroli esikuxelela ukuba ingakanani ipetroli emotweni yakho, nesilinganisi sokujikeleza kwenjini esikuxelela ukuba injini ijikeleza ngokukhawuleza kangakanani. Izilinganisi ezininzi zineendawo zesilumkiso eziphawulwe ngombala obomvu ukukubonisa xa uqala ukuphuma kwimida ekhuselekileyo. Jonga izilinganisi ngamaxesha athile ukuze uqinisekise ukuba kukhuselekile ukuqhuba okanye ubone ukuba kufuneka uthathe inyathelo.
  • Intonga yokulawula izisuli Intonga yokulawula izisuli ilawula izisuli zeglasi yangaphambili. Inokuba kwelinye icala levili lokuqhuba ngokuxhomekeke kuhlobo lwemoto. Kufuneka uvule izisuli zeglasi yangaphambili xa kunetha ukuze iglasi ihlale icacile kwaye uqinisekise ukuba uyayibona indlela ephambi kwakho. Izisuli zinokusetyenziselwa nokucoca iglasi yangaphambili ukuba uqala ngokutshiza amanzi kuyo (ngokuqhelekileyo usebenzisa iqhosha elikwintonga yokulawula izisuli). Ukuba usebenzisa izisuli iglasi yangaphambili yomile, zinokuyikrwela kancinci kwaye ngamanye amaxesha zisasaze uthuli kuyo, nto leyo eyenza kube nzima ukubona.
